Role Classification: Project Management
Employment Type: Contract- Fixed term project based
Program Duration: 21 months

Job Purpose
The Project Manager will lead the end-to-end re-implementation of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and associated Oracle applications across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Projects, Warehouse Management, and Human Resources functions. The role will be responsible for delivering the ERP transformation program on time, within budget, and to the agreed quality standards while ensuring alignment with business objectives and operational requirements.

Scope of the Oracle EBS re-implementation

The Project Manager will lead the re-implementation and integration of the following Oracle modules:

Financial Management
• Oracle Payables
• Oracle Receivables
• Oracle Cash Management
• Oracle General Ledger
• Oracle Fixed Assets
• Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)
Supply Chain & Procurement
• Oracle Inventory
• Oracle Purchasing
• Oracle iProcurement
• Oracle Warehouse Management
• Oracle Spares Management
Manufacturing & Planning
• Material Requirements Planning (MRP)
• Oracle Process Manufacturing (OPM)
• Oracle Process Manufacturing Process Planning
• Oracle Process Manufacturing Process Execution
• Oracle Process Manufacturing Quality Management
Order Fulfillment
• Order Management
Human Capital Management
• Oracle Core HRMS
Project Management
• Oracle Projects

Key Responsibilities
• Provide overall program leadership and governance.
• Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, and resources.
• Coordinate business stakeholders, implementation partners, and technical teams.
• Lead business process transformation, testing, change management, and training.
• Oversee data migration, integrations, cutover, and go-live activities.
• Report progress to executives and steering committees.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Business, Finance, Engineering, or related fields.
• MBA preferred.
• PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent.
• Oracle certification.
Experience Requirements
• 5 years of project management experience including leading Oracle ERP/EBS implementations in the manufacturing industry.
• Experience across Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, and HR functions.
Core Competencies
• Leadership
• Stakeholder Management
• Vendor Management
• Change Management
• Risk Management
• Financial Acumen
• Communication and Negotiation

name: Sales Representative
text: Our Client is in the process of filling vacant position of Sales Representative in their Sales & Marketing Department reporting to the General Trade Head. The ideal candidate should meet the following requirements: - THE ROLE: SALES REPRESENTATIVE To be a single point of contact for all sales operations related aspects (e.g. Field Sales, Distribution, Asset Management etc.) within assigned geographical “Area/Territory” and deliver agreed objectives/targets. PURPOSE: Effectively manage all Order to Cash processes to maximize customer service levels from available stock at optimal distribution cost. Main accountabilities of the Sales Representative will include: - • Achieving of Sales Volume/Value Target through distribution by focusing on Sell-In and Sell-Out. Managing Days Sales outstanding as per the Order to cash process. • Liaising with Sales & Marketing Director on effective coverage system for the Priority Channels within the Territory of Jurisdiction. • Ensuring quality of 4P’s in the Priority Channels i.e. Distribution of Must sell SKU’s in each Priority Channel, Retail Pricing Objectives, Placement and Merchandising Targets are met. Executing daily monitory of customer’s performance against defined KPIs (Sales out, Inventory level, Order placement on time etc. • Executing the Channel Category plans at the Point of Purchase (POP) within the Sales Cycle Plan. Supporting the development of Field Sales and Channel Category Plans by providing feedback on the Cycle Plan activities execution. • Managing Coolers, Freezers and other Asset Management in the territory of jurisdiction. Ensure contracts are signed with customers who have Del Monte Assets and maintain Asset Register and ensure repairs of the said assets reflect what is on the ground. • Providing quality and o-time information on Demand Forecast by Customer, Computerized Coverage Reports, Value Chain pricing. • Coaching, motivating and developing Distributors’ or direct sales force. Requirements The ideal candidates should meet the following requirements:- • University degree in Commerce, Economics or Business Administration (with bias in Marketing) or an equivalent qualification. • Preferred 2 years working experience in a Fast Moving Consumer Goods environment. • Demonstrate detailed understanding of the core sales capabilities of order generation, delivery, merchandising and account development. ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES: 1. Pleasant, results oriented, hardworking, and a team player who possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills. 2. Able to conclude tasks in a timely manner and under little or no supervision. 3. Well versed with MS Office (specifically Excel) with demonstrable ability to carry out data analysis and generate reports.

text: Department: Business Growth Reports to : Chief Executive Officer Location: Nairobi, Kenya Employment Full-time Direct oversight Marketing; Revenue & Data; Business Development Level Head of Department Role Purpose The Head of Business Development & Growth is responsible for leading the company’s growth strategy across Marketing, Revenue & Data, and Business Development.The role oversees the complete sales and revenue funnel—from generating and tracking leads to improving conversion, growing revenue, forming strategic partnerships, and expanding the property portfolio. Key Responsibilities 1. Growth Strategy & Planning ● Develop annual and quarterly growth plans aligned with company priorities and budgets. ● Set and monitor targets for revenue, occupancy, leads, conversions, partnerships, and portfolio growth. ● Oversee the full sales funnel, from lead generation to conversion and retention. ● Review performance, address gaps, and report forecasts and recommendations to the CEO. 2. Marketing & Customer Acquisition ● Set the strategy for brand visibility, lead generation, and customer acquisition. ● Oversee SEO implementation and marketing campaigns. ● Ensure marketing supports bookings, occupancy, client acquisition, and portfolio growth. ● Monitor campaign performance, lead conversion, and acquisition costs. 3. Revenue & Commercial Performance ● Set and monitor revenue, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and channel targets. ● Ensure pricing responds to demand, seasonality, and market conditions. ● Review forecasts, booking trends, promotions, and portfolio performance. ● Develop recovery plans for underperforming units and improve portfolio returns. 4. Business Development, Strategic Partnerships & Market Expansion ● Develop relationships with corporates, NGOs, relocation agencies, property agents, landlords, developers, and other strategic partners. ● Create strategies to acquire viable properties, clients, new units, and commercial partnerships. ● Identify opportunities to expand into new locations, property segments, and customer markets. ● Lead strategic pitches, negotiations, and high-value commercial engagements. ● Set and monitor targets for leads, partnerships, signed agreements, and portfolio growth. 5. Client Retention & Revenue Expansion ● Develop strategies for client retention, repeat bookings, referrals, renewals, and additional revenue. ● Use client feedback and lost opportunities to improve the company’s offering. ● Align the growth departments around shared targets and priorities. ● Address cross-departmental challenges and escalate significant commercial risks to the CEO. Requirements Qualifications & Experience ● Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Hospitality, Real Estate or a related field. ● 6 - 8 years’ relevant experience in business development, commercial growth, sales, revenue management or a related field, including leadership responsibility. ● Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline, interpret performance data and develop practical growth plans. ● Experience in hospitality, property management, real estate or serviced apartments is an advantage. ● Proven ability to negotiate, influence stakeholders and support high-value commercial agreements. ● Strong leadership, communication, commercial judgement, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. Core Competencies Strategic thinking • Commercial judgement • Sales-funnel management • Revenue analysis • Data-driven decision-making • Team leadership • Partnership development • Negotiation • Forecasting • Client relationship management • Clear reporting
html:
Department: Business Growth
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Employment Full-time
Direct oversight Marketing; Revenue & Data; Business Development
Level Head of Department

Role Purpose

The Head of Business Development & Growth is responsible for leading the company’s growth strategy across Marketing, Revenue & Data, and Business Development.The role oversees the complete sales and revenue funnel—from generating and tracking leads to improving conversion, growing revenue, forming strategic partnerships, and expanding the property portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

1. Growth Strategy & Planning
● Develop annual and quarterly growth plans aligned with company priorities and budgets.
● Set and monitor targets for revenue, occupancy, leads, conversions, partnerships, and portfolio growth.
● Oversee the full sales funnel, from lead generation to conversion and retention.
● Review performance, address gaps, and report forecasts and recommendations to the CEO.
2. Marketing & Customer Acquisition
● Set the strategy for brand visibility, lead generation, and customer acquisition.
● Oversee SEO implementation and marketing campaigns.
● Ensure marketing supports bookings, occupancy, client acquisition, and portfolio growth.
● Monitor campaign performance, lead conversion, and acquisition costs.
3. Revenue & Commercial Performance
● Set and monitor revenue, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and channel targets.
● Ensure pricing responds to demand, seasonality, and market conditions.
● Review forecasts, booking trends, promotions, and portfolio performance.
● Develop recovery plans for underperforming units and improve portfolio returns.
4. Business Development, Strategic Partnerships & Market Expansion
● Develop relationships with corporates, NGOs, relocation agencies, property agents, landlords, developers, and other strategic partners.
● Create strategies to acquire viable properties, clients, new units, and commercial partnerships.
● Identify opportunities to expand into new locations, property segments, and customer markets.
● Lead strategic pitches, negotiations, and high-value commercial engagements.
● Set and monitor targets for leads, partnerships, signed agreements, and portfolio growth.
5. Client Retention & Revenue Expansion
● Develop strategies for client retention, repeat bookings, referrals, renewals, and additional revenue.
● Use client feedback and lost opportunities to improve the company’s offering.
● Align the growth departments around shared targets and priorities.
● Address cross-departmental challenges and escalate significant commercial risks to the CEO.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience
● Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Hospitality, Real Estate or a related field.
● 6 - 8 years’ relevant experience in business development, commercial growth, sales, revenue management or a related field, including leadership responsibility.
● Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline, interpret performance data and develop practical growth plans.
● Experience in hospitality, property management, real estate or serviced apartments is an advantage.
● Proven ability to negotiate, influence stakeholders and support high-value commercial agreements.
● Strong leadership, communication, commercial judgement, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
Core Competencies
Strategic thinking • Commercial judgement • Sales-funnel management • Revenue analysis • Data-driven decision-making • Team leadership • Partnership development
• Negotiation
• Forecasting
• Client relationship management
• Clear reporting

name: Property Manager
text: Department Client Relations Reports to Reservations Manager Location Nairobi, Kenya Employment Full-time Level Account Manager Role Purpose The Property Account Manager is responsible for managing and maintaining strong relationships with landlords and property owners, acting as their main point of contact and ensuring property-related requests, concerns, approvals, renewals, and other matters are effectively coordinated and followed through.The role is also responsible for managing relationships with long-term clients, ensuring regular communication, timely resolution of concerns, coordination of their stay requirements, and support throughout their client journey, including renewals, extensions, and move-out. Key Responsibilities 1. Landlord & Property Owner Relationship Management ● Serve as the main point of contact and maintain strong relationships with landlords and property owners. ● Manage landlord communication, updates, requests and concerns, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution. ● Conduct regular check-ins and escalate significant concerns or disputes when necessary. 2. Long-Term Client Relationship Management ● Serve as the main point of contact and maintain strong relationships with long-term clients. ● Manage client requests and concerns, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution. ● Manage stay extensions, renewals and move-out communication while supporting client retention. 3. Internal Department Coordination ● Coordinate with Housekeeping, Repairs & Maintenance, Reservations, Finance and other relevant teams on landlord and long-term client matters. ● Ensure requests are assigned to the responsible department and followed through to completion. ● Follow up on outstanding actions and agreed timelines. ● Escalate delays or recurring issues affecting landlord or client relationships. 4. Repairs, Maintenance & Property Issues ● Coordinate repair and maintenance matters with landlords, long-term clients, and the Repairs & Maintenance team. ● Obtain landlord approvals where required and provide updates on significant repairs. ● Follow up on repairs through to completion and maintain relevant documentation. 5. Property Onboarding & Offboarding ● Coordinate property onboarding and offboarding with landlords and relevant internal teams. ● Ensure all required documentation, inventories, snagging, property condition, access, utilities and handover requirements are completed. ● Coordinate repairs, outstanding matters, deposits and final landlord handover where applicable. Requirements Qualifications & Experience ● Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Customer Service, Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, or a related field. ● Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in Customer Service, Client Relations, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role. ● Experience handling client relationships, complaints, escalations, and service resolution. ● Strong communication, relationship management, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. ● Experience in hospitality, serviced apartments, real estate, or property management is an added advantage. Core Competencies Excellent communication and interpersonal skills • Strong coordination, follow-up and organizational skills. • Good negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills. • Strong problem-solving and escalation management • High attention to detail and accountability • Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities.
html:
Department Client Relations
Reports to Reservations Manager
Location Nairobi, Kenya
Employment Full-time
Level Account Manager

Role Purpose

The Property Account Manager is responsible for managing and maintaining strong relationships with landlords and property owners, acting as their main point of contact and ensuring property-related requests, concerns, approvals, renewals, and other matters are effectively coordinated and followed through.The role is also responsible for managing relationships with long-term clients, ensuring regular communication, timely resolution of concerns, coordination of their stay requirements, and support throughout their client journey, including renewals, extensions, and move-out.

Key Responsibilities

1. Landlord & Property Owner Relationship Management
● Serve as the main point of contact and maintain strong relationships with landlords and property owners.
● Manage landlord communication, updates, requests and concerns, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.
● Conduct regular check-ins and escalate significant concerns or disputes when necessary.
2. Long-Term Client Relationship Management
● Serve as the main point of contact and maintain strong relationships with long-term clients.
● Manage client requests and concerns, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.
● Manage stay extensions, renewals and move-out communication while supporting client retention.
3. Internal Department Coordination
● Coordinate with Housekeeping, Repairs & Maintenance, Reservations, Finance and other relevant teams on landlord and long-term client matters.
● Ensure requests are assigned to the responsible department and followed through to completion.
● Follow up on outstanding actions and agreed timelines.
● Escalate delays or recurring issues affecting landlord or client relationships.
4. Repairs, Maintenance & Property Issues
● Coordinate repair and maintenance matters with landlords, long-term clients, and the Repairs & Maintenance team.
● Obtain landlord approvals where required and provide updates on significant repairs.
● Follow up on repairs through to completion and maintain relevant documentation.
5. Property Onboarding & Offboarding
● Coordinate property onboarding and offboarding with landlords and relevant internal teams.
● Ensure all required documentation, inventories, snagging, property condition, access, utilities and handover requirements are completed.
● Coordinate repairs, outstanding matters, deposits and final landlord handover where applicable.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

● Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Customer Service, Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, or a related field.
● Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in Customer Service, Client Relations, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role.
● Experience handling client relationships, complaints, escalations, and service resolution.
● Strong communication, relationship management, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
● Experience in hospitality, serviced apartments, real estate, or property management is an added advantage.

Core Competencies

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Strong coordination, follow-up and organizational skills.
• Good negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
• Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
• Strong problem-solving and escalation management
• High attention to detail and accountability
• Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities.

name: Pre-Sales Executive (French Speaking)
text: ROLE OVERVIEW The Presales Executive - Francophone Africa is a bilingual commercial role responsible for supporting the Client's sales teams across French-speaking African markets. This person will prepare bids, proposals, and tender responses in both English and French, conduct product demonstrations for francophone prospects, and manage POC engagements across markets including DRC, Senegal, Ivory Coast, and other Francophone territories. The ideal candidate is fluent in French, commercially confident, outspoken in client settings, and brings a genuine understanding of how enterprise technology decisions are made in Francophone African markets. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Identify and track tender opportunities across Francophone African procurement portals, government listings, banking and healthcare institutions, and donor-funded procurement platforms in target markets • Prepare and submit end-to-end RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, EOIs, and formal tender responses in both English and French, compliant with OHADA frameworks and local procurement regulations • Develop bilingual technical and commercial proposals including cost estimates, solution descriptions, scope of work, and capability statements tailored to Francophone market requirements • Conduct product demonstrations of the full client suite (QMS, VQMS, Self-Service Kiosks, Digital Signage, Appointment Booking, CX CRM, CX Portal) to prospective clients across banking, healthcare, and enterprise sectors in Francophone markets • Plan, coordinate, and manage Proof-of-Concept (POC) engagements from scoping through execution, including bilingual documentation, client feedback, and commercial follow-through • Support client discovery and needs analysis sessions to position the right Marezi solution for each francophone prospect • Prepare accurate bilingual quotations in coordination with country sales representatives, aligned to approved pricing and commercial frameworks • Maintain a tender calendar and compliance matrix to ensure zero missed deadlines across concurrent multi-market submissions • Manage and update CRM records in Zoho with accurate deal stages, proposal statuses, and activity logs across all Francophone accounts • Produce regular reports in English on bid activity, demo pipeline, POC status, and win and loss analysis for leadership MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS • French language fluency at C1 minimum - written and spoken. You will draft proposals, lead demonstrations, and communicate with clients in French daily • Strong English communication - all internal reporting, leadership updates, and cross-team coordination are conducted in English • Proven experience in bid, tender, RFP, RFQ, and RFI preparation with direct ownership of the full submission process • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pricing models, trackers), Word (bilingual proposal formatting), and PowerPoint (presentations and demos) • Hands-on experience with a CRM system for pipeline and activity management - Zoho CRM experience is strongly preferred • Confidence and presence in client-facing settings including demonstrations, presentations, and POC reviews in both languages B2B EXPERIENCE IS A MUST Requirements QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE • Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Telecommunications, Commerce, or a related field • Minimum 2 years of experience in a presales, bids, or commercial coordination role - ICT, technology, or enterprise solutions environment preferred • Experience conducting product demonstrations or supporting POC engagements in a technology context is a strong advantage • Familiarity with Francophone African procurement environments - OHADA legal frameworks, donor-funded processes (World Bank, UNDP), or government tendering in DRC, Senegal, or Ivory Coast • Sales or account management background is a meaningful advantage PERSONALITY AND SOFT SKILLS • Outspoken, confident, and commercially energetic - comfortable leading client meetings and demonstrations in French without prompting • Culturally aware and adaptable across different Francophone markets - understands that DRC, Senegal, and Ivory Coast require different commercial approaches • Highly organised and deadline-driven with the ability to manage multiple concurrent bids across multiple markets • Proactive self-starter who identifies opportunities and drives engagement independently across a remote, distributed team • Collaborative and dependable - sales reps in francophone markets rely on this person to deliver professional, accurate bilingual output on time ADVANTAGEOUS • Direct lived or professional experience in DRC, Senegal, Ivory Coast, Cameroon, or another Francophone African market • Existing relationships with enterprise banking or healthcare clients in Francophone Africa • Familiarity with donor-funded procurement processes (World Bank, UNDP, USAID, AFD)
html:
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Presales Executive - Francophone Africa is a bilingual commercial role responsible for supporting the Client's sales teams across French-speaking African markets. This person will prepare bids, proposals, and tender responses in both English and French, conduct product demonstrations for francophone prospects, and manage POC engagements across markets including DRC, Senegal, Ivory Coast, and other Francophone territories. The ideal candidate is fluent in French, commercially confident, outspoken in client settings, and brings a genuine understanding of how enterprise technology decisions are made in Francophone African markets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Identify and track tender opportunities across Francophone African procurement portals, government listings, banking and healthcare institutions, and donor-funded procurement platforms in target markets
• Prepare and submit end-to-end RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, EOIs, and formal tender responses in both English and French, compliant with OHADA frameworks and local procurement regulations
• Develop bilingual technical and commercial proposals including cost estimates, solution descriptions, scope of work, and capability statements tailored to Francophone market requirements
• Conduct product demonstrations of the full client suite (QMS, VQMS, Self-Service Kiosks, Digital Signage, Appointment Booking, CX CRM, CX Portal) to prospective clients across banking, healthcare, and enterprise sectors in Francophone markets
• Plan, coordinate, and manage Proof-of-Concept (POC) engagements from scoping through execution, including bilingual documentation, client feedback, and commercial follow-through
• Support client discovery and needs analysis sessions to position the right Marezi solution for each francophone prospect
• Prepare accurate bilingual quotations in coordination with country sales representatives, aligned to approved pricing and
commercial frameworks
• Maintain a tender calendar and compliance matrix to ensure zero missed deadlines across concurrent multi-market submissions
• Manage and update CRM records in Zoho with accurate deal stages, proposal statuses, and activity logs across all Francophone accounts
• Produce regular reports in English on bid activity, demo pipeline, POC status, and win and loss analysis for leadership

MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS

• French language fluency at C1 minimum - written and spoken. You will draft proposals, lead demonstrations, and communicate with clients in French daily
• Strong English communication - all internal reporting, leadership updates, and cross-team coordination are conducted in English
• Proven experience in bid, tender, RFP, RFQ, and RFI preparation with direct ownership of the full submission process
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pricing models, trackers), Word (bilingual proposal formatting), and
PowerPoint (presentations and demos)
• Hands-on experience with a CRM system for pipeline and activity management - Zoho CRM experience is strongly preferred
• Confidence and presence in client-facing settings including demonstrations, presentations, and POC reviews in both languages
B2B EXPERIENCE IS A MUST


Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Telecommunications, Commerce, or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a presales, bids, or commercial coordination role - ICT, technology, or enterprise solutions environment preferred
• Experience conducting product demonstrations or supporting POC engagements in a technology context is a strong advantage
• Familiarity with Francophone African procurement environments - OHADA legal frameworks, donor-funded processes (World Bank, UNDP), or government tendering in DRC, Senegal, or Ivory Coast

Role Overview As part of our client Microsoft Dynamics 365 program, the Finance & Operations (F&O) Developer will build the internal technical capability needed to support and extend the ERP platform. Working closely with key users across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations, this role translates business needs into clearly documented technical requirements and delivers the X++ customizations, extensions, reports, and integrations that support them. This is a hands-on, in-house role with long-term ownership of the F&O solution — from requirements capture through development, testing, deployment, data migration support, and ongoing optimization. Development & Configuration • Develop customizations and extensions using X++ following the extension framework (no overlayering). • Build and modify tables, forms, data entities, workflows, and security objects (roles, duties, privileges). • Develop SSRS reports and configure Electronic Reporting (ER/GER) where required. • Create and maintain batch jobs and automated processes. Integration & Data • Build and maintain integrations using OData, custom services, the Data Management Framework (DMF), Logic Apps, and Azure Functions. • Configure Dual-write integration with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement. • Support data migration activities using DMF and data packages. Quality, Deployment & Support • Manage ALM through Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS): code branching, builds, and deployments. • Conduct unit testing, support SIT and UAT, and troubleshoot and resolve defects. • Carry out performance tuning and query optimization. • Provide post-go-live support and continuous enhancements. • Maintain accurate technical documentation and contribute to an internal knowledge base. Requirements Required Technical Skills • Strong X++ development experience on Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain (F&O). • Solid command of the extension framework, Visual Studio development tools, and the F&O metadata model. • Data entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), SSRS reporting, and Electronic Reporting (ER). • Integration experience: OData, custom services, recurring integrations, Azure-based integrations, and Dual-write. • Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Azure DevOps build/release pipelines with Git. • Strong SQL skills and performance-tuning experience. • Working understanding of F&O functional areas (GL, AP, AR, Inventory, Procurement, Production). Qualifications & Certifications • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field (a background in Finance/Accounting combined with IT is an advantage). • 3–5+ years of hands-on Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX) development across the full implementation lifecycle. • Microsoft certifications strongly preferred : MB-500 (Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Apps Developer) and/or MB-300 (Dynamics 365 Core Finance and Operations). Preferred / Nice to Have • Functional knowledge of finance and supply-chain business processes. • Experience with data migration on large or multi-entity implementations. • Exposure to Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure data services. Core Competencies & Soft Skills • Strong requirements-elicitation skills — able to interview key users, ask the right questions, and convert business language into clear technical specifications. • Excellent written documentation skills (technical design documents, configuration guides, test scripts). • Analytical and structured problem-solving with attention to detail. • Clear communicator able to work directly with non-technical business users and functional consultants. • Self-driven, organized, and able to manage multiple work items against deadlines. • Collaborative team player comfortable working with implementation partners and internal stakeholders.

Job Title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Developer
(Finance & Operations — In-House Technical Role)
Reporting & Working Relationships
Reports to: IT / Applications Manager (or designated ERP Project Lead)
Position type: Full-time, internal (in-house) role
Works closely with: Finance and operations key users, functional consultants, the CRM developer, and the implementation partner.

Role Overview
As part of our client Microsoft Dynamics 365 program, the Finance & Operations (F&O) Developer will build the internal technical capability needed to support and extend the ERP platform. Working closely with key users across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations, this role translates business needs into clearly documented technical requirements and delivers the X customizations, extensions, reports, and integrations that support them.
This is a hands-on, in-house role with long-term ownership of the F&O solution — from requirements capture through development, testing, deployment, data migration support, and ongoing optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Technical Design
• Work with key users and functional consultants to capture, analyze, and document technical requirements across Finance and Operations modules.
• Translate Functional Design Documents (FDDs) into Technical Design Documents (TDDs) with clear, maintainable solution designs.
• Advise on feasibility, effort, and best-practice approaches that respect the F&O extension model.

Development & Configuration
• Develop customizations and extensions using X following the extension framework (no overlayering).
• Build and modify tables, forms, data entities, workflows, and security objects (roles, duties, privileges).
• Develop SSRS reports and configure Electronic Reporting (ER/GER) where required.
• Create and maintain batch jobs and automated processes.

Integration & Data
• Build and maintain integrations using OData, custom services, the Data Management Framework (DMF), Logic Apps, and Azure Functions.
• Configure Dual-write integration with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement.
• Support data migration activities using DMF and data packages.

Quality, Deployment & Support
• Manage ALM through Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS): code branching, builds, and deployments.
• Conduct unit testing, support SIT and UAT, and troubleshoot and resolve defects.
• Carry out performance tuning and query optimization.
• Provide post-go-live support and continuous enhancements.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation and contribute to an internal knowledge base.

Requirements

Required Technical Skills
• Strong X development experience on Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain (F&O).
• Solid command of the extension framework, Visual Studio development tools, and the F&O metadata model.
• Data entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), SSRS reporting, and Electronic Reporting (ER).
• Integration experience: OData, custom services, recurring integrations, Azure-based integrations, and Dual-write.
• Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Azure DevOps build/release pipelines with Git.
• Strong SQL skills and performance-tuning experience.
• Working understanding of F&O functional areas (GL, AP, AR, Inventory, Procurement, Production).

Qualifications & Certifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field (a background in Finance/Accounting combined with IT is an advantage).
• 3–5 years of hands-on Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX) development across the full implementation lifecycle.
• Microsoft certifications strongly preferred: MB-500 (Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Apps Developer) and/or MB-300 (Dynamics 365 Core Finance and Operations).

Preferred / Nice to Have
• Functional knowledge of finance and supply-chain business processes.
• Experience with data migration on large or multi-entity implementations.
• Exposure to Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure data services.

Core Competencies & Soft Skills
• Strong requirements-elicitation skills — able to interview key users, ask the right questions, and convert business language into clear technical specifications.
• Excellent written documentation skills (technical design documents, configuration guides, test scripts).
• Analytical and structured problem-solving with attention to detail.
• Clear communicator able to work directly with non-technical business users and functional consultants.
• Self-driven, organized, and able to manage multiple work items against deadlines.
• Collaborative team player comfortable working with implementation partners and internal stakeholders.

**Contract type:** Fixed Term Appointment   

**Duty Station:** Nairobi

**Location:** Kenya   

**Categories:** Executive Management   

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children's lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.   

At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job -- it is a calling.   

UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.   

Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.   

**For every child, *the right to an advocate*** Kenya's population stands at approximately 53.3 million and is expected to continue growing, with a demographic structure heavily skewed towards young people. Children account for about 41.3 per cent of the population, equivalent to roughly 22 million. Overall, nearly 73 per cent of the population is under the age of 35, underscoring a predominantly youthful demography. Kenya's governance system is devolved at sub-national level called "Counties" with main development sectors as county responsibility supported by the divisible pool of central government.   

Kenya's macroeconomic performance in recent years has remained broadly stable, with sustained growth despite emerging fiscal and external pressures. Since 2021, the economy has recorded consistent GDP growth above 4.5 per cent, reflecting post-pandemic recovery and resilience in key sectors such as production and services.   

Despite sustained economic growth, poverty and inequality continue to affect a large proportion of Kenya's children particularly in ASAL and Western Kenya as they continue to face significant barriers to realizing their rights and potential. This underscores the importance of their participation, ensuring that policies and investments respond to the realities they face in their communities.   

UNICEF's impactful, multisectoral programmes reached over 18 million children, women, and adults in 2025, transforming lives in Kenya through health, education, nutrition, water, sanitation, and protection initiatives. Systems were strengthened, and access to life-saving and life-enhancing support was brought to the most vulnerable populations. UNICEF empowered youth through skill-building and employability via innovative projects like the BeGreen and EKYAN. Working collaboratively within the UN system, we played a pivotal role in implementing joint UN programmes and advancing the overall results of the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF). Kenya, being a lower middle income country with a positive trajectory of becoming a middle income soon, private sector and foundations are a strong part of partnership architecture along with the government Donors.   

**How can you make a difference** **?** The Deputy Representative reports to the CO Representative for general supervision and direction. The Deputy Representative serves as the principal adviser on the overall management of the CO, development of CO policies and strategies; and under delegated authority, for coordinating and managing all phases of the Country Office Programme, from formulation to delivery of results in accordance with UNICEF's Strategic Plans, standards of performance and accountability framework, ethics, and integrity.   

The Deputy Representative together with Chief/Partnerships supports the Representative in leading and leveraging partnerships with both public and private sectors for the achievement of results and fulfilment of the rights of children.   

In fragile and humanitarian settings, the Deputy Representative is accountable for the delivery of a timely, efficient and principled humanitarian programmes, in accordance with UNICEF global Policy and Framework for humanitarian action.

* CO Programme planning and development
* Support to the Representative on managing the CO
* Monitoring and quality control of Programmes
* Representation, alliance building and UN System coordination

* Innovation, knowledge management and capacity building

name: Finance and Programme Associate Consultant (Home based)
text: Job Description Background UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security The work of UN Women’s Ending Violence against Women (EVAW) Section is focused on a comprehensive approach to ending violence against women that addresses legislation and policies, prevention, services for survivors, research and data, creating safe public spaces in different settings and strengthening women’s rights movements to end violence against women. In this context UN Women together with the UN Trust Fund to End Violence against Women is implementing the ACT to end Violence against Women and Girls Programme, funded by the European Union to strengthen women’s rights movements, coalition building and advocacy to end gender-based violence against women and girls Under the supervision of the Programme Management Specialist and a matrix supervision by the Regional Coordinator, EVAW, The Finance and Programme Associate is responsible for promoting a client-oriented approach consistent with UN Women rules and regulations, standard practices and guidelines. The post holder will be part of the Global and the East and Southern Africa Regional Office teams, as well as collaborate closely with the Regional Programme Coordinators and Programme Associates who are located in Panama, and Senegal and the UN Trust Fund ACT Programme team. The postholder will also collaborate closely with the operations Team in Nairobi and the EU Financial Specialist located in Brussels, and the HQ Finance and Budget Teams for solving complex finance or budget-related issues and delivering information to ensure successful implementation, monitoring and reporting of the ACT to end violence against women programme Description Of Responsibilities /Scope Of Work Implement financial strategies for the effective and timely delivery of the HQ EVAW Programme, in full compliance of UN Women rules, regulations, policies, and recording and reporting systems Perform duties in full compliance with UN Women financial regulations and rules, policies and standard operating procedures, including internal controls Review and verify financial transactions, activities, and documentation; html:
Job Description

Background

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security

The work of UN Women’s Ending Violence against Women (EVAW) Section is focused on a comprehensive approach to ending violence against women that addresses legislation and policies, prevention, services for survivors, research and data, creating safe public spaces in different settings and strengthening women’s rights movements to end violence against women. In this context UN Women together with the UN Trust Fund to End Violence against Women is implementing the ACT to end Violence against Women and Girls Programme, funded by the European Union to strengthen women’s rights movements, coalition building and advocacy to end gender-based violence against women and girls

Under the supervision of the Programme Management Specialist and a matrix supervision by the Regional Coordinator, EVAW, The Finance and Programme Associate is responsible for promoting a client-oriented approach consistent with UN Women rules and regulations, standard practices and guidelines. The post holder will be part of the Global and the East and Southern Africa Regional Office teams, as well as collaborate closely with the Regional Programme Coordinators and Programme Associates who are located in Panama, and Senegal and the UN Trust Fund ACT Programme team. The postholder will also collaborate closely with the operations Team in Nairobi and the EU Financial Specialist located in Brussels, and the HQ Finance and Budget Teams for solving complex finance or budget-related issues and delivering information to ensure successful implementation, monitoring and reporting of the ACT to end violence against women programme

Description Of Responsibilities /Scope Of Work

Implement financial strategies for the effective and timely delivery of the HQ EVAW Programme, in full compliance of UN Women rules, regulations, policies, and recording and reporting systems
  • Perform duties in full compliance with UN Women financial regulations and rules, policies and standard operating procedures, including internal controls
  • Review and verify financial transactions, activities, and documentation; taking corrective actions as needed and reporting any unusual activities
  • Monitor financial exceptions reports for unusual activities or transaction, investigate anomalies and report to the supervisor conclusions and/or present recommendations for actions/decisions
  • Draft reports on financial status, procedures, exchange rates, costs and expenditures
  • Follow-up on audit recommendations to monitor implementation of corrective actions
  • Collect, verify and present information and data for use in the planning of financial resources and the revision of the global and regional programme work plans, budgets, proposals on implementation arrangements and execution modalities
  • Assist in Annual Work Plan entry in Performance & Results Integrated System for Management (PRISM) as required
  • Provide advice and recommend solutions to a wide range of financial issues experienced by the global and regional programme staff
  • Monitor the proper functioning of the financial resources management system for programmatic budgets and resources
  • Implement cost-saving and reduction strategies


Monitor programmatic budget for the global component and for the ESARO regional component of the EVAW Programme in full compliance with UN Women rules, regulations, policies, and recording and reporting systems
  • Monitor the budget, control allotments, expenditures, and prepare revisions according to the needs of the project teams
  • Track the appropriate and timely use of financial resources
  • Prepare cost recovery documents or bills for the services provided by UN Women to other programmes or organizations
  • Implement and maintain control mechanisms for development projects through monitoring budgets preparation and modifications and budgetary status
  • Maintain internal expenditure control system
  • Undertake corrective actions on un-posted invoices with budget check errors, match exceptions and unapproved Invoices. Respond to RO /HQ requests to resolve financial data issues
  • Prepare VAT reimbursements with adequate documentation support
  • Input data in QUANTUM and monitor status. Keep stakeholders and clients informed for timely action and/or decisions
    • Manage petty cash fund, cash impress level
    • Prepare budget revisions, revise project awards and status; and determine unutilized funds and the operational and financial close of a project
    • Prepare financial reports for global component and the ESARO regional component of programme and consolidate report for all components of programme
    • Maintain internal expenditures control system


Provide administrative and logistical support to the formulation and management of programmes and the financial management of the Global Component and the ESARO regional component of the Programme
  • Provide administrative support in the preparation of programme work plans, budgets, and proposals on programme implementation arrangements
  • Provide technical guidance to the executing agencies on routine delivery and reporting of programme-supported activities and finances
  • Prepare information for the audit of programmes/ projects and support implementation of audit recommendations
    • Provide administrative support in monitoring budget preparation and the finances of programmes/projects including the finalization of FACE forms
    • Create requisitions in QUANTUM for development projects; register good receipts in QUANTUM
    • Prepare non-PO Invoices for the global component and the ESARO regional component of the programme
    • Process payment for consultants
  • Support undertaking all logistical, administrative and financial arrangements for organization for meetings, workshops, events, and missions
  • Make travel arrangements for the Programme Team, including travel requisitions and claims
  • Provide guidance and training to Regional Programme Assistants and civil society partners as needed for the implementation of programmes, the preparation of financial reports as per partner agreement or small grants agreement
  • Provide administrative support to resource mobilization

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy

III. Competencies

Core Values:

  • Respect for Diversity
  • Integrity
  • Professionalism


Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues
  • Accountability
  • Creative Problem Solving
  • Effective Communication
  • Inclusive Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leading by Example


Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Core Values and Competencies https://www.unwomen.org/en/about-us/employment/application-process#_Values

FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Strong knowledge of financial rules and regulations and accounting principles
  • Strong knowledge and application skills of IT tools and understanding of management systems
  • Strong knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages
  • Ability to provide input to business processes re-engineering, implementation of new systems
  • Ability to administer and execute financial and accounting processes and transactions


IV. Required Qualifications

Education and Certification:
  • Completion of secondary education is required
  • Specialized national or international certification in accounting and finance is an asset
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting is an asset
  • Successful completion of UN Women Accounting and Finance Test is an asset


Experience:
  • At least 6 years of progressively responsible experience in finance
  • Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc) and spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling of web-based management systems
  • Experience in the use of a modern web-based ERP System, preferably Oracle Cloud, is required
  • Experience with EU funded projects is desirable
  • Experience of supporting a programme on ending violence against women/gender equality is desirable


Languages:
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable


Statements

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

Position Overview


The Production Designer is a detail-oriented, highly organized role responsible for supporting the day-to-day production needs of a real estate company's creative team and its agent marketing services division — a paid marketing service that provides customized marketing support to individual real estate agents. Reporting to the Graphic Designer, this role will primarily focus on producing, adapting, and preparing marketing assets within established brands and design systems.


The Production Designer will also have opportunities to support the broader brand through social media content, digital advertising, and other creative projects. This is approximately a 70% production / 30% design role and is ideal for someone who enjoys the production side of design, works quickly and accurately, and takes genuine pride in getting the details right.



Key Responsibilities


Agent Marketing Services Support

• Work directly with the Graphic Designer to execute customized marketing projects for individual real estate agents, adapting existing creative to each agent's personal brand and marketing needs

• Produce accurate, polished, agent-specific marketing assets efficiently and within established timelines


Marketing Design Center Production

• Build, upload, and prepare editable marketing assets within the company's Marketing Design Center (MDC)

• Ensure templates are properly formatted and fully functional for agent customization

• Maintain template libraries so assets are organized, current, and easy to access


Design Adaptation & Versioning

• Adapt, resize, and reformat existing designs and templates for print, digital, social media, and other marketing channels

• Maintain brand consistency across all versions and formats throughout the adaptation process

• Produce multiple versions of assets quickly without sacrificing accuracy or quality


Production & Revisions

• Execute design updates, revisions, and production requests quickly and accurately

• Manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines without losing detail or momentum

• Incorporate feedback efficiently and return revised assets within agreed turnaround windows


Creative Design Support

• Create new marketing materials as needed to support the broader marketing team

• Support the Graphic Designer and creative team on projects requiring additional design capacity

• Contribute creative input where appropriate while operating primarily in a production and execution role


Digital & Social Creative

• Support the development of social media content and digital advertising assets for channels including Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms

• Produce digital creative that is correctly sized, formatted, and visually consistent with brand standards for each platform


File Management

• Prepare, organize, and maintain design files and creative assets to support efficient production, collaboration, and future use

• Follow consistent naming conventions and folder structures so files are always easy to locate and hand off


Brand Consistency & Quality Assurance

• Follow established brand guidelines, templates, and design systems to maintain visual consistency across all projects

• Review designs and templates for accuracy, formatting, functionality, and overall quality before final delivery or publication

• Catch errors at the production stage — typos, misaligned elements, incorrect specs, and brand inconsistencies — before they reach the client or go live


Team Collaboration

• Work closely with the Graphic Designer and broader Marketing team, incorporating feedback and supporting additional production and creative needs as priorities evolve

• Communicate proactively on project status, timelines, and any blockers



Qualifications


• Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite — particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign

• Experience with Canva or similar template-based design platforms is a plus

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and consistency — this is the single most important trait for this role

• Basic understanding of design principles, typography, and layout

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

• Comfortable adapting existing designs, templates, and brand systems — you follow the rules and execute them well

• Ability to work efficiently, follow direction, and incorporate feedback quickly

• Quick learner who is comfortable picking up new software, platforms, and workflows

• Dependable, collaborative, and comfortable working as part of a creative team



What Makes You a Great Fit


• You move fast and you move accurately — speed without errors is your standard

• You notice when something is off — a misaligned logo, an incorrect font, a wrong color — and you fix it before it ships

• You are just as engaged on your tenth production task as you were on your first

• The Graphic Designer can hand you a project brief and trust the output will be on brand, on spec, and on time

• You take pride in the production side of design because you understand that execution is where creative ideas actually come to life



This is a full time role

Rate is $6-$7/hr depending on experience

100% Remote


To apply, please complete this assessment: https://assessment.aptiveindex.com/s/PhxtPhtP3Jt7

Team Collaboration

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

• Comfortable adapting existing designs, templates, and brand systems --- you follow the rules and execute them well

• Ability to work efficiently, follow direction, and incorporate feedback quickly

• Quick learner who is comfortable picking up new software, platforms, and workflows

• Dependable, collaborative, and comfortable working as part of a creative team

What Makes You a Great Fit

• You move fast and you move accurately --- speed without errors is your standard

• You notice when something is off --- a misaligned logo, an incorrect font, a wrong color --- and you fix it before it ships

• You are just as engaged on your tenth production task as you were on your first

• The Graphic Designer can hand you a project brief and trust the output will be on brand, on spec, and on time

Wavetronix, the global leader in radar-based vehicle detection technologies, is seeking a full-time Sales Manager for the Upper Midwest Territory. This role is responsible for identifying market opportunities, developing relationships with industry contacts, and growing revenue through direct sales to customers throughout the region.

The ideal candidate will have prior technical sales experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to travel extensively throughout the territory. Although traffic industry experience is preferred, talented sales professionals with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.

This position has been strategically aligned with Wavetronix's long-term vision for the region. Team members are expected to live within the Upper Midwest region ( allowing for regular onsite collaboration when not supporting customers in the field. While the team currently operates remotely throughout the territory, Wavetronix plans to establish a permanent office location in the region within the next few years.

Regional Sales Representative

Territory Sales Manager

Technical Sales Representative

ITS Sales Manager

Account Manager

A Successful Sales Manager Will

Customer Relationships & Sales Growth
  • Develop and maintain relationships of trust with customers throughout the region
  • Understand customer business objectives and traffic challenges
  • Recommend Wavetronix products and applications that solve customer problems
  • Generate repeat business and long-term customer loyalty
  • Manage and expand the customer base within the territory
  • Identify new market opportunities and grow regional sales

Technical & Industry Expertise
  • Learn and effectively demonstrate Wavetronix products and solutions
  • Develop a strong understanding of ITS, traffic detection, and related technologies
  • Maintain awareness of competitors, product offerings, pricing, and market trends
  • Provide product, technical, pricing, and delivery information to customers

Communication & Teamwork
  • Successfully collaborate with teammates to achieve regional and company goals
  • Attend customer meetings, trade shows, and industry events
  • Negotiate agreements within company profitability guidelines
  • Respond promptly to customer concerns and warranty claims
  • Build credibility with customers through professional communication and follow-through

Planning & Business Management
  • Prepare sales forecasts and regional growth plans
  • Track opportunities and manage territory activities effectively
  • Identify regional requirements necessary to meet customer needs and grow the marketplace
  • Align with company programs, initiatives, and strategic objectives
  • Participate in ongoing professional and personal development opportunities

Work Style & Travel
  • Be self-motivated and results-oriented
  • Enjoy building relationships and working directly with customers
  • Demonstrate strong technical aptitude and a willingness to learn
  • Travel throughout the territory as needed (approximately 70-75%)
  • Participate in onsite collaboration when not traveling

Sales Manager Development Milestones

First 90 Days
  • Successfully complete onboarding and training
  • Increase industry knowledge in ITS and traffic detection
  • Learn how Wavetronix products solve detection challenges at intersections and on highways
  • Understand how traffic information derived from detection supports customer decision-making
  • Attend customer meetings alongside experienced sales team members

Within 1 Year
  • Prepare and deliver product presentations and demonstrations
  • Attend trade shows and professional industry meetings
  • Establish trusted customer relationships throughout the region
  • Learn customer business needs and recommend effective Wavetronix solutions
  • Successfully integrate with the regional team and contribute to shared goals
  • Generate sales that meet or exceed annual targets
  • Provide timely product, technical, pricing, and delivery information
  • Develop a working knowledge of competitors, products, pricing, and sales strategies
  • Participate in Wavetronix continuing education and development programs

Beyond Year 1
  • Manager and expand the customer base throughout the region
  • Identify market opportunities and regional requirements needed to support growth
  • Prepare and execute sales plans, budgets, and forecasts
  • Meet or exceed regional sales objectives
  • Drive alignment with company initiatives and contribute to long-term regional growth

Why Wavetronix?

Wavetronix is the global leader in radar-based vehicle detection technology. Our sales team works with a wide variety of customers, including traffic engineers, transportation agencies, consultants, and industry leaders. Successful team members combine strong relationship-building skills with technical expertise to help customers solve real-world traffic challenges and improve transportation systems. We do not have commission-based sales roles, because true sales in our industry take months of client interactions involving many people at our company. We know that winning business is a team effort and we earn trust by showing the value of working with Wavetronix, in both our products and our people.

Benefits

Wavetronix offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees and their families, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with a 5% company match
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with a 2:1 company match
  • Company-provided vehicle for business use
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • And much more!

About Wavetronix

Wavetronix' purpose is to enable rewarding careers and foster personal development. We do this by creating innovative technologies that make the world's roads safer and more efficient. Our core values include putting people first and embracing a growth mindset. We encourage continuous learning and long-term growth, creating opportunities for individuals and those around them to thrive.

If you share our values and have the education and experience to help us create the most talented workforce in the traffic radar industry, we encourage you to apply.

Wavetronix is an affirmative action equal opportunity employer. Wavetronix participates in the E-Verify program.

name: Suyian Executive Chef
text: &Beyond is built, almost entirely, on the strength of remarkable people who give passionately to their roles, work tirelessly, have the guest experience at the core of their focus daily and care for the sustainability of our communities and environment. Every single '&Beyonder' makes a huge difference to our success and our contribution to the world, regardless of their role or function. For this reason, we choose '&Beyonders' very carefully - they are the strength and the future of this company. We are looking for an experienced and passionate Executive Chef to lead the culinary team at &Beyond Suyian Lodge in Laikipia, Kenya . The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all daily kitchen operations and delivering exceptional culinary experiences to both guests and staff. The role requires a strong and inspiring leader who can develop and motivate a team, maintain exceptional &Beyond food and service standards, manage food costs and kitchen administration, and continually evolve the lodge's culinary offering. The ideal candidate will have previous experience within a luxury lodge environment, a strong understanding of the operational requirements of working in a remote location, and a genuine passion for guest delight, sustainability and developing people. This reflects the scope of the current Suyian Executive Chef position. KEY OUTPUTS Administration Responsibility for effective kitchen cost management and adherence to budget. Manage all kitchen ordering and purchasing, taking into consideration Suyian's remote location and associated logistics. Maintain strong knowledge of products, local suppliers, pricing and current stock levels. Manage inventory and ensure timely and accurate ordering. Conduct and oversee monthly stocktakes and ensure accurate reporting. Monitor food costs per head for both guests and staff and identify opportunities to improve efficiencies without compromising the guest offering. Report and follow up on broken, unusable or unsafe kitchen equipment. Manage kitchen rosters, schedules, leave and staffing requirements. Maintain accurate kitchen administration, records and personnel documentation. Work closely with the General Manager and Finance team to ensure appropriate financial and operational controls are maintained. Food Safety & Hygiene Maintain exceptional kitchen hygiene standards at all times. Ensure all guest dietary requirements and allergies are understood, communicated and adhered to. Maintain the cold chain and correct food temperatures. Ensure HACCP principles and all applicable &Beyond and Kenyan health and safety requirements are followed. Ensure correct storage, labelling and rotation of all food products. Maintain appropriate stock levels of approved cleaning chemicals and materials. Ensure preventative maintenance programmes are followed. Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained correctly and remains in safe working order. Maintain exceptional grooming and personal hygiene standards across the kitchen team. Ensure the health and safety of guests, staff and lodge assets through regular inspections and adherence to safety procedures. Menu Planning & Execution Develop innovative menus in collaboration with the Regional Executive Chef that reflect the &Beyond food philosophy, Suyian's identity, local culture and seasonality. Ensure menus incorporate sustainable and locally sourced ingredients wherever possible. Maintain accurate recipes and costing for dishes prepared and served at the lodge. Ensure consistently exceptional food quality, flavour, presentation and portioning. Ensure all products are prepared consistently and meet &Beyond appearance and quality standards. Remain current with international food trends and have a strong understanding of different world cuisines. Ensure all guest dietary requirements and special requests are catered for with precision and care. Control wastage and continually identify opportunities to reduce food waste. Oversee all bush dining, picnics, game-drive snacks, special events and other culinary experiences. Ensure all meals are presented fresh and to the required &Beyond standard. Review guest feedback regularly and implement improvements where required. Achieve and consistently maintain a minimum 95% food score in guest feedback. Staff Management Provide disciplined, inspirational leadership and effective management of the Suyian kitchen team. Be a positive role model and maintain fair and consistent standards of discipline. Train, develop and motivate all levels of kitchen staff to consistently meet and exceed established standards. Conduct daily departmental meetings to align the team on guests, priorities and operational requirements. Identify talent within the team and actively promote retention, development and succession. Set clear performance expectations and monitor individual and departmental performance. Provide regular coaching, guidance and constructive feedback. Delegate responsibility appropriately to develop supervisors and junior team members. Ensure all kitchen staff are appropriately trained in food safety, health and hygiene. Ensure kitchen staff attend relevant training workshops and exchanges. Maintain high levels of professionalism, morale and teamwork. Manage staff performance, rosters, leave and attendance appropriately. Ensure disciplinary processes and documentation are managed in accordance with &Beyond policies and procedures. Ensure the kitchen team is informed of relevant lodge happenings, guest requirements and &Beyond updates. Guest Delight Engage confidently and professionally with guests and actively invite feedback on food quality, presentation and service. Make personal contact with guests throughout their stay to understand their preferences and dietary requirements. Host and interact with guests to ensure they feel personally attended to. Actively respond to and resolve food-related guest concerns and complaints. Lead pre-service meetings with chefs and butlers to align teams on guest preferences, dietary requirements and special events. Work closely with the General Manager, Lodge Manager, Head Guide and other Heads of Department to deliver seamless guest experiences. Create memorable and innovative bush dining and special culinary experiences. Review guest feedback and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
