&Beyond is built, almost entirely, on the strength of remarkable people who give passionately to their roles, work tirelessly, have the guest experience at the core of their focus daily and care for the sustainability of our communities and environment. Every single '&Beyonder' makes a huge difference to our success and our contribution to the world, regardless of their role or function. For this reason, we choose '&Beyonders' very carefully - they are the strength and the future of this company.

We are looking for an experienced and passionate Executive Chef to lead the culinary team at &Beyond Suyian Lodge in Laikipia, Kenya.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all daily kitchen operations and delivering exceptional culinary experiences to both guests and staff. The role requires a strong and inspiring leader who can develop and motivate a team, maintain exceptional &Beyond food and service standards, manage food costs and kitchen administration, and continually evolve the lodge's culinary offering. The ideal candidate will have previous experience within a luxury lodge environment, a strong understanding of the operational requirements of working in a remote location, and a genuine passion for guest delight, sustainability and developing people. This reflects the scope of the current Suyian Executive Chef position.

KEY OUTPUTS

Administration
  • Responsibility for effective kitchen cost management and adherence to budget.
  • Manage all kitchen ordering and purchasing, taking into consideration Suyian's remote location and associated logistics.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of products, local suppliers, pricing and current stock levels.
  • Manage inventory and ensure timely and accurate ordering.
  • Conduct and oversee monthly stocktakes and ensure accurate reporting.
  • Monitor food costs per head for both guests and staff and identify opportunities to improve efficiencies without compromising the guest offering.
  • Report and follow up on broken, unusable or unsafe kitchen equipment.
  • Manage kitchen rosters, schedules, leave and staffing requirements.
  • Maintain accurate kitchen administration, records and personnel documentation.
  • Work closely with the General Manager and Finance team to ensure appropriate financial and operational controls are maintained.

Food Safety & Hygiene
  • Maintain exceptional kitchen hygiene standards at all times.
  • Ensure all guest dietary requirements and allergies are understood, communicated and adhered to.
  • Maintain the cold chain and correct food temperatures.
  • Ensure HACCP principles and all applicable &Beyond and Kenyan health and safety requirements are followed.
  • Ensure correct storage, labelling and rotation of all food products.
  • Maintain appropriate stock levels of approved cleaning chemicals and materials.
  • Ensure preventative maintenance programmes are followed.
  • Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained correctly and remains in safe working order.
  • Maintain exceptional grooming and personal hygiene standards across the kitchen team.
  • Ensure the health and safety of guests, staff and lodge assets through regular inspections and adherence to safety procedures.

Menu Planning & Execution
  • Develop innovative menus in collaboration with the Regional Executive Chef that reflect the &Beyond food philosophy, Suyian's identity, local culture and seasonality.
  • Ensure menus incorporate sustainable and locally sourced ingredients wherever possible.
  • Maintain accurate recipes and costing for dishes prepared and served at the lodge.
  • Ensure consistently exceptional food quality, flavour, presentation and portioning.
  • Ensure all products are prepared consistently and meet &Beyond appearance and quality standards.
  • Remain current with international food trends and have a strong understanding of different world cuisines.
  • Ensure all guest dietary requirements and special requests are catered for with precision and care.
  • Control wastage and continually identify opportunities to reduce food waste.
  • Oversee all bush dining, picnics, game-drive snacks, special events and other culinary experiences.
  • Ensure all meals are presented fresh and to the required &Beyond standard.
  • Review guest feedback regularly and implement improvements where required.
  • Achieve and consistently maintain a minimum 95% food score in guest feedback.

Staff Management
  • Provide disciplined, inspirational leadership and effective management of the Suyian kitchen team.
  • Be a positive role model and maintain fair and consistent standards of discipline.
  • Train, develop and motivate all levels of kitchen staff to consistently meet and exceed established standards.
  • Conduct daily departmental meetings to align the team on guests, priorities and operational requirements.
  • Identify talent within the team and actively promote retention, development and succession.
  • Set clear performance expectations and monitor individual and departmental performance.
  • Provide regular coaching, guidance and constructive feedback.
  • Delegate responsibility appropriately to develop supervisors and junior team members.
  • Ensure all kitchen staff are appropriately trained in food safety, health and hygiene.
  • Ensure kitchen staff attend relevant training workshops and exchanges.
  • Maintain high levels of professionalism, morale and teamwork.
  • Manage staff performance, rosters, leave and attendance appropriately.
  • Ensure disciplinary processes and documentation are managed in accordance with &Beyond policies and procedures.
  • Ensure the kitchen team is informed of relevant lodge happenings, guest requirements and &Beyond updates.

Guest Delight
  • Engage confidently and professionally with guests and actively invite feedback on food quality, presentation and service.
  • Make personal contact with guests throughout their stay to understand their preferences and dietary requirements.
  • Host and interact with guests to ensure they feel personally attended to.
  • Actively respond to and resolve food-related guest concerns and complaints.
  • Lead pre-service meetings with chefs and butlers to align teams on guest preferences, dietary requirements and special events.
  • Work closely with the General Manager, Lodge Manager, Head Guide and other Heads of Department to deliver seamless guest experiences.
  • Create memorable and innovative bush dining and special culinary experiences.
  • Review guest feedback and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Understand and embrace the requirements of working in a remote luxury safari environment.
  • Live and breathe the &Beyond ethos.

Skills Required
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong communication skills with guests, colleagues and team members.
  • Exceptional culinary and food presentation skills.
  • Strong leadership and people-management ability.
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills.
  • Strong financial awareness and cost-control ability.
  • Lateral thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • Initiative and the ability to work independently.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a remote environment.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Guest-focused and service-driven.
  • Honest, professional and of high integrity.
  • Proactive, motivated and career-driven.
  • Computer literate.
  • Commitment to &Beyond's world-class hospitality and service standards.

Knowledge Required
  • Luxury hospitality and lodge operations.
  • Food safety, hygiene and HACCP principles.
  • Menu development, recipe costing and food-cost management.
  • Stock control, procurement and remote logistics.
  • Current international food trends and world cuisines.
  • Sustainable food practices, local sourcing and waste reduction.
  • The local environment and surrounding communities.
  • Kenya and the East African safari environment.
  • &Beyond company knowledge, values and sustainability philosophy.

Previous Work Experience Required
  • Experience within the service industry in 5-star luxury establishments.
  • A minimum of 5+ years' relevant experience as an Executive Chef or in a comparable senior culinary leadership position.
  • Previous experience in a luxury safari lodge or similarly remote hospitality environment is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, training and developing a kitchen team.
  • Strong experience in menu development, food costing, stock management and kitchen administration.
  • A recognised culinary degree or diploma.
  • A genuine passion for creating exceptional food and memorable guest experiences.

We reserve the right not to make an appointment.

name: Senior Partner Manager, Enterprise
text: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Partner Manager, Enterprise based in Kenya. This is a senior partnership role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with enterprise digital agencies and technology partners. You’ll manage a portfolio of high-value partners and help drive revenue, retention, adoption, and long-term growth. The role combines commercial strategy, relationship management, partner enablement, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders while identifying new opportunities across existing accounts and partner ecosystems. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and executive teams to deliver mutual business outcomes. The environment is fully remote, international, and highly collaborative, with opportunities to represent the organization at major industry events. This role is ideal for an experienced partnership professional who enjoys autonomy, strategic ownership, and building scalable partner programs. Accountabilities Drive revenue through strategic partner channels, identifying and developing new commercial opportunities with digital agencies and enterprise partners. Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and enablement through retention, expansion, and renewal. Develop and execute high-impact partner strategies designed to improve retention, net revenue retention, adoption, and overall partner growth. Build trusted-advisor relationships with partner organizations, helping them strengthen their technology practices, deliver successful projects, and grow their businesses. Engage senior and executive stakeholders through strategic presentations, business reviews, training, enablement sessions, and targeted partner communications. Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Partnerships, and leadership teams to align partner priorities and commercial initiatives. Develop joint marketing and sales enablement programs that generate demand, improve product awareness, and strengthen partner engagement. Attend and support major industry events and partner gatherings, using these opportunities to build relationships, generate leads, and increase market visibility. Gather and communicate partner feedback to influence product, service, and partnership improvements. Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and ecosystem developments, using insights to refine partnership strategies. Ensure strategic partners understand and adhere to relevant standards, expectations, and compliance requirements. Identify opportunities to strengthen the broader partner ecosystem and create scalable approaches to partner growth. Requirements 8+ years of experience in Partner Management, Relationship Management, Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar commercial role within technology, SaaS, or media. Demonstrated success managing a substantial portfolio of partners while achieving or exceeding retention, revenue, and growth targets. Experience working with Global System Integrators or System Integrators to establish alliances, introduce technology practices, and scale partnerships. Strong commercial and relationship-management skills, with proven experience negotiating and influencing C-suite and senior executive stakeholders. Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage audiences through executive presentations, group sessions, written communication, and one-to-one conversations. Strong understanding of partner ecosystems, digital agencies, technology solutions, and the broader web or software landscape. Ability to understand and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Highly collaborative approach and confidence working across geographically distributed internal and external teams. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally when required for partner meetings, conferences, and industry events. Adaptability and curiosity, with the ability to respond effectively to evolving technologies, market conditions, and competitive dynamics. Experience with enterprise partnerships, international markets, partner-sourced revenue, or regional growth programs is highly valuable. Familiarity with WordPress, web technologies, hosting, development tools, or related agency ecosystems is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary range of $125,000–$180,000 USD plus commission, with compensation paid in local currency. Compensation may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and expected contribution. Fully remote working environment with significant flexibility. Open vacation policy to support sustainable work and personal wellbeing. Country-specific benefits and perks available according to location. Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team spanning more than 1500 employees across numerous countries and time zones. Exposure to a broad international partner ecosystem and major technology and industry events. Opportunities to contribute to an open-source-driven technology environment and work across well-known web and commerce products. 📌 Position: BI Product Manager - Financial Market

Location: Remote from LATAM

Contract Type: Full-time vendor (Direct contract with Inallmedia.com)

Time Zone Alignment: CST ±2 hours

🧭 About Inallmedia.com

Inallmedia.com is a global technology and design firm focused on building impactful digital solutions through remote, distributed teams across LATAM. We partner with international clients across industries, providing long-term technical expertise, product innovation, and team augmentation.

🚀 Project Overview

This role embeds within a core Financial Data and Business Intelligence product team, serving as the subject-matter expert across Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) domains for an enterprise platform.

Acting with a proactive "hunter" mindset at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Accounting, and Product, you will identify operational friction points across the revenue lifecycle and convert them into high-impact data products, automated BI dashboards, and enterprise AI/ML analytics solutions. You will play a pivotal role in shaping financial data strategy to optimize downstream decision-making.

🔍 Key Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Outreach & Gap Mapping: Actively build relationships across internal Financial Systems (FinSys) teams—including Orders, Invoicing, Billing, Legal, and Finance leadership—to identify process gaps and map operational friction points.
  • Data Product Strategy & Discovery: Connect operational pain points directly to Business Intelligence (BI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI opportunities, articulating the business rationale behind financial data needs.
  • Requirements & Specifications Authoring: Author clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), functional specifications, and strategic roadmaps, translating complex business needs into non-technical requirements for Technical Delivery Managers (TDMs) and data engineering teams.
  • Cross-Domain Process Alignment: Ensure complex Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes—including quoting, deal structuring, billing, entitlement, and revenue recognition—are accurately modeled within downstream data and analytics products.
  • Data Validation & Reporting: Validate pricing, order, and contract data to build operational dashboards, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and support core enterprise business reporting.

💡 Must-Have Skills

  • 5 Years of FinSys PM Experience: Solid background in Product Management within Financial Systems (FinSys BI), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Quote-to-Cash (Q2C), or Revenue Operations in SaaS/Tech environments.
  • Financial & Accounting Expertise: Deep understanding of core accounting concepts, billing systems, entitlements, contract lifecycles, and downstream revenue recognition rules (specifically ASC 606 impacts).
  • System Data Flows: Strong understanding of how enterprise data flows from ERP platforms (Workday, NetSuite, SAP) and CPQ/CLM tools (Salesforce CPQ, Zuora, Conga, Icertis, DocuSign CLM, Ironclad) into centralized BI platforms.
  • Analytical & Functional Design Skills: Proven track record in data validation, process mapping, user storytelling, and writing clear functional requirements (PRDs).
  • Cross-Functional Communication: High-energy, proactive approach to engaging busy finance, legal, product, and sales stakeholders to align on process maps and data requirements.
  • Agile & Remote Experience: Demonstrated experience working effectively in Agile teams and remote, distributed environments.
  • Fluent English: Native or professional bilingual fluency for all daily written and spoken communication.

🌟 Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Modern Data & AI Literacy: Conceptual understanding of modern data stack architecture and practical business applications of GenAI, LLMs, or predictive ML models within corporate finance.
  • High-Volume SaaS/Marketplace Experience: Previous experience working within high-volume marketplaces or enterprise sales operations handling complex deal structures.
  • Contract Analytics & Process Optimization: Experience in contract analytics, obligation tracking, or process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) applied to financial platforms.

🌐 Time Zone & Collaboration

The role requires close collaboration with global teams aligned to CST (CST ±2 hours). Flexibility to overlap standard business hours with US time zones is expected. All contract management and operations will be handled directly by Inallmedia.com.

💬 Language

All interviews, technical documentation, stakeholder meetings, and daily team communications will be conducted in English.

name: Growth Lead, Institutional Partnerships (East Africa)
text: Position: Growth Lead, Institutional Partnerships (East Africa) Team: Growth Level and grade: L7 Director Position type: Full time; engagement basis set by country of residence Location: East Africa. Nairobi, Kampala, Kigali, Dar es Salaam or Addis Ababa. Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Travel: 40 to 50 percent across the region, occasionally beyond Mandate : The East Africa pipeline from first conversation to signed contract About Us APLYD helps governments, multilateral institutions, development finance institutions and foundations use AI in public systems. Most public-sector AI stops at the pilot. Our work is getting it into everyday service delivery and keeping it running once we leave. Athena Infonomics has done this work for years. In 2026 we set it up as its own company. We cover strategy and readiness, field data and last-mile reach, design and build, evaluation and audit, and scale and production. 440+ engagements 240+ global clients 85+ specialists 7 countries 5 continents The Role You open East Africa for APLYD. The role runs from the first conversation with a ministry, a regional body, a multilateral country office or a development finance institution to a signed contract, and it carries a revenue target. It is a growth role rather than a country profit-and-loss role: delivery is staffed from APLYD's global disciplines, with people in the region when the work requires it. You are the first APLYD hire in the region and you build the team around you, starting with an Associate, Growth (East Africa). You carry a revenue target, and part of your pay is linked to the revenue you originate. Origination credit starts from the first contract you close, the rate increases once you pass target, and there is no cap. In your first year, qualified opportunities you originated that have reached contracting are also credited, because East African institutional cycles often take longer than a financial year. Core Job Responsibilities Represent APLYD in East Africa. For most institutions in the region you will be the first person from the firm they meet, and what you commit to on our behalf, we deliver. Own institutional opportunities from the first conversation to a signed contract: problem definition, scoping, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and a handover that gives the delivery team everything it needs. Decide what we pursue and what we decline. Not every funded opportunity is one we should take. Set the technical expectation before anyone commits to it. Work with senior stakeholders until the problem statement is precise, and hold a credible position on solution architecture, data and AI feasibility, integration constraints, and who owns and operates the system once it is live. Own the proposals: scope, technical approach, timeline, risk, commercial model and budget. At this stage you write the important ones yourself. Read the region for us. Ministries and agencies across several countries, regional bodies, multilaterals, bilateral agencies and philanthropies all decide and budget differently, and the answers change across borders. Keep the pipeline accurate: what is live, what has stalled and what will not happen. Report to the Chief Executive Officer. Hire and lead the Associate, Growth (East Africa), and build the regional team as revenue allows. Qualifications And Competencies Twenty or more years in business development, partnerships or institutional growth across government systems, development organisations or major funders, with most of that time in East Africa. You have taken a new institutional relationship to a signed, funded contract more than once. Current networks across East African governments, regional institutions, multilaterals, bilateral agencies and the philanthropies active in the region. You know how public systems and large development institutions work in the region, and where those answers change across borders. Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation about AI and data systems, digital public infrastructure, feasibility and architecture. You have been the senior person in the room when an institution decided whether to work with a firm. Based in East Africa, with willingness to travel 40 to 50 percent. Also useful, though we will not screen on it AI, digital transformation, technology-for-development or digital public infrastructure work in Africa. Relationships with county or sub-national governments, and with funders running significant East Africa portfolios. Time in an organisation working at the intersection of evidence, technology and public service delivery on the continent. Additional Requirements This position requires successful completion of a reference check and employment verification. The successful candidate must not be subject to employment restrictions from a former employer, such as a non-compete, that would prevent performance of the responsibilities described. Candidates must declare any current or recent engagement with a government, multilateral or development finance institution that could present a conflict of interest. APLYD’s Work Culture At APLYD, we function in an outcomes-based work environment with flexible hours and a high level of autonomy. Professional development and thought leadership are key elements of our business model: we support our team members’ professional growth through on-the-job training, and we encourage the cultivation of our colleagues’ personal brands through participation in panels, events, publications, and other thought-leadership opportunities. Position: Growth Lead, Institutional Partnerships (East Africa)

Team: Growth

Level and grade: L7 Director

Position type: Full time; engagement basis set by country of residence

Location: East Africa. Nairobi, Kampala, Kigali, Dar es Salaam or Addis Ababa.

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Travel: 40 to 50 percent across the region, occasionally beyond

Mandate: The East Africa pipeline from first conversation to signed contract

About Us

APLYD helps governments, multilateral institutions, development finance institutions and foundations use AI in public systems. Most public-sector AI stops at the pilot. Our work is getting it into everyday service delivery and keeping it running once we leave.

Athena Infonomics has done this work for years. In 2026 we set it up as its own company. We cover strategy and readiness, field data and last-mile reach, design and build, evaluation and audit, and scale and production.

440+ engagements

  • 240+ global clients
  • 85+ specialists
  • 7 countries
  • 5 continents

The Role

You open East Africa for APLYD. The role runs from the first conversation with a ministry, a regional body, a multilateral country office or a development finance institution to a signed contract, and it carries a revenue target. It is a growth role rather than a country profit-and-loss role: delivery is staffed from APLYD's global disciplines, with people in the region when the work requires it.

You are the first APLYD hire in the region and you build the team around you, starting with an Associate, Growth (East Africa).

You carry a revenue target, and part of your pay is linked to the revenue you originate. Origination credit starts from the first contract you close, the rate increases once you pass target, and there is no cap. In your first year, qualified opportunities you originated that have reached contracting are also credited, because East African institutional cycles often take longer than a financial year.

Core Job Responsibilities
  • Represent APLYD in East Africa. For most institutions in the region you will be the first person from the firm they meet, and what you commit to on our behalf, we deliver.
  • Own institutional opportunities from the first conversation to a signed contract: problem definition, scoping, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and a handover that gives the delivery team everything it needs.
  • Decide what we pursue and what we decline. Not every funded opportunity is one we should take.
  • Set the technical expectation before anyone commits to it. Work with senior stakeholders until the problem statement is precise, and hold a credible position on solution architecture, data and AI feasibility, integration constraints, and who owns and operates the system once it is live.
  • Own the proposals: scope, technical approach, timeline, risk, commercial model and budget. At this stage you write the important ones yourself.
  • Read the region for us. Ministries and agencies across several countries, regional bodies, multilaterals, bilateral agencies and philanthropies all decide and budget differently, and the answers change across borders.
  • Keep the pipeline accurate: what is live, what has stalled and what will not happen. Report to the Chief Executive Officer.
  • Hire and lead the Associate, Growth (East Africa), and build the regional team as revenue allows.

Qualifications And Competencies
  • Twenty or more years in business development, partnerships or institutional growth across government systems, development organisations or major funders, with most of that time in East Africa.
  • You have taken a new institutional relationship to a signed, funded contract more than once.
  • Current networks across East African governments, regional institutions, multilaterals, bilateral agencies and the philanthropies active in the region.
  • You know how public systems and large development institutions work in the region, and where those answers change across borders.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation about AI and data systems, digital public infrastructure, feasibility and architecture.
  • You have been the senior person in the room when an institution decided whether to work with a firm.
  • Based in East Africa, with willingness to travel 40 to 50 percent.

Also useful, though we will not screen on it
  • AI, digital transformation, technology-for-development or digital public infrastructure work in Africa.
  • Relationships with county or sub-national governments, and with funders running significant East Africa portfolios.
  • Time in an organisation working at the intersection of evidence, technology and public service delivery on the continent.

Additional Requirements
  • This position requires successful completion of a reference check and employment verification.
  • The successful candidate must not be subject to employment restrictions from a former employer, such as a non-compete, that would prevent performance of the responsibilities described.
  • Candidates must declare any current or recent engagement with a government, multilateral or development finance institution that could present a conflict of interest.

APLYD’s Work Culture

At APLYD, we function in an outcomes-based work environment with flexible hours and a high level of autonomy. Professional development and thought leadership are key elements of our business model: we support our team members’ professional growth through on-the-job training, and we encourage the cultivation of our colleagues’ personal brands through participation in panels, events, publications, and other thought-leadership opportunities. We embrace a transparent, open work environment with meaningful leadership pathways for those with inventive ideas and initiatives.

APLYD is an Equal Opportunities Employer

APLYD, part of the Athena Infonomics group, is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

AI Proficiency and Responsible Use

Proficiency in the responsible and sophisticated use of AI is a mandatory requirement for all roles, across all levels and functions at APLYD and Athena Infonomics.

Posted Monday, August 31, 2026 at 4:00 AM

About The Chefs' Warehouse

The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. (http://www.chefswarehouse.com) combines exceptional quality and brand building with broadline food service distribution for more than 40 years. With Protein, Specialty, Produce, and Broadline offerings, we service the most discerning chefs in a hybrid approach of convenience and superior quality. We introduce more than 4,000 artisan producers of the world’s finest ingredients from over 40 countries to the finest chefs in the world. We passionately consult, sell, and build relationships with more than 50,000 customers through the most experienced network of over 600 consultive sales associates, best-in-breed technology, rapid service, and support levels that solidify our long-standing ties to both established and up-and-coming premium restaurants.

Mission: The mission of The Chefs’ Warehouse is to provide the world’s greatest ingredients to the world’s best chefs.

Our C.H.E.F.S. Values

Curious & Creative

Hungry For Food & Results

Entrepreneurial

Forward Thinking & Flexible

Supportive (Of Peers & Chefs)

The Chef’s Warehouse is the preferred choice for foodservice professionals who demand the best, offering a curated selection of specialty ingredients, center-of-plate proteins, and produce sourced globally and locally. Our team of specialty, protein, and produce experts works closely with chefs to meet the highest standards and elevate the guest experience. Our trusted sales representatives are among the best in the industry, helping customers discover new possibilities and craft exceptional culinary experiences. We’re seeking a driven, customer-focused professional who thrives on building relationships and delivering innovative food service solutions.

If you’re passionate about food, sales, and growing business through personalized service, this is the role for you!

Position Summary

As a Sales Associate at The Chef’s Warehouse, you ultimately act as the face of our company by delivering outstanding customer service and building and maintaining strong relationships. You will be responsible for selling our fine products to restaurants, caterers, hotels, and retail establishments by performing the following duties:

  • Growing Revenue: Generate sales through the development of new business opportunities and by expanding relationships with existing accounts
  • Building Customer Portfolio: Compile lists of prospective customers for use as sale leads that are based on information from networking, newspapers, business directories, industry ads, trade shows, websites, and other sources
  • Staying On The Move: Travel throughout your assigned territory and call on existing and prospective customers to secure orders
  • Showcasing Our Value: Present our products using samples or catalogs that highlight key features and benefits that fit customer needs
  • Sealing The Deal: Quote prices and credit terms to prepare contracts for orders obtained
  • Maintaining Timelines: Provide estimated date of delivery to customers that is based on knowledge of our production and delivery schedules as well as collect payments from customers in a timely manner
  • Staying Organized: Maintain detailed records of business transactions, update expense reports, keep internal systems current with customer and sales data, and manage account receivables
  • Connecting & Teaming Up: Collaborate with inside sales representatives to keep account activities and literature up to date
  • Managing Inventory Awareness: Track stock levels to align product availability with customer demand
  • Building Lasting Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with purchasing contracts that are rooted in trust and built for long-term collaboration

How To Thrive In This Role
  • Relevant Experience: 1-2 years of experience in restaurant sales, food sales, professional catering sales, and/or working as a Chef is highly desired and preferred
  • Positive Attitude: High energy, enthusiastic, a strong team player, and motivated to take responsibility and ensure successful outcomes despite obstacles
  • Relevant Skills: Excellent organizational skills, outstanding verbal and written communication skills used to develop a culture of participation and involvement, and ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects and initiatives
  • Self-Starter: Eager to ask questions and learn new skills quickly on the job
  • Education: College degree desired but not required
  • Leader: Able to foster a positive and innovative atmosphere that motivates others to take initiative and go above and beyond to achieve key objectives
  • Data-Driven: Comfortable with gathering facts and figures to monitor individual and team progress in a timely and accurate manner
  • Determined: Brings a sense of urgency to our fast-paced environment so that tight deadlines are met with short turnarounds

Minimum Qualifications
  • Must live within a commutable distance to the assigned geographic sales area
  • Must have a reliable form of transportation
  • Must have basic computer skills and understanding
  • Must have some proficiency in Microsoft Suite

Why Join The Chef’s Warehouse
  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission plan
  • Travel reimbursement

Job Description

Posted Monday, August 31, 2026 at 4:00 AM

About The Chefs' Warehouse

The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. (http://www.chefswarehouse.com) combines exceptional quality and brand building with broadline food service distribution for more than 40 years. With Protein, Specialty, Produce, and Broadline offerings, we service the most discerning chefs in a hybrid approach of convenience and superior quality. We introduce more than 4,000 artisan producers of the world’s finest ingredients from over 40 countries to the finest chefs in the world. We passionately consult, sell, and build relationships with more than 50,000 customers through the most experienced network of over 600 consultive sales associates, best-in-breed technology, rapid service, and support levels that solidify our long-standing ties to both established and up-and-coming premium restaurants.

Mission: The mission of The Chefs’ Warehouse is to provide the world’s greatest ingredients to the world’s best chefs.

Our C.H.E.F.S. Values

Curious & Creative

Hungry For Food & Results

Entrepreneurial

Forward Thinking & Flexible

Supportive (Of Peers & Chefs)

The Chef’s Warehouse is the preferred choice for foodservice professionals who demand the best, offering a curated selection of specialty ingredients, center-of-plate proteins, and produce sourced globally and locally. Our team of specialty, protein, and produce experts works closely with chefs to meet the highest standards and elevate the guest experience. Our trusted sales representatives are among the best in the industry, helping customers discover new possibilities and craft exceptional culinary experiences. We’re seeking a driven, customer-focused professional who thrives on building relationships and delivering innovative food service solutions.

If you’re passionate about food, sales, and growing business through personalized service, this is the role for you!

Position Summary

As a Sales Associate at The Chef’s Warehouse, you ultimately act as the face of our company by delivering outstanding customer service and building and maintaining strong relationships. You will be responsible for selling our fine products to restaurants, caterers, hotels, and retail establishments by performing the following duties:

  • Growing Revenue: Generate sales through the development of new business opportunities and by expanding relationships with existing accounts
  • Building Customer Portfolio: Compile lists of prospective customers for use as sale leads that are based on information from networking, newspapers, business directories, industry ads, trade shows, websites, and other sources
  • Staying On The Move: Travel throughout your assigned territory and call on existing and prospective customers to secure orders
  • Showcasing Our Value: Present our products using samples or catalogs that highlight key features and benefits that fit customer needs
  • Sealing The Deal: Quote prices and credit terms to prepare contracts for orders obtained
  • Maintaining Timelines: Provide estimated date of delivery to customers that is based on knowledge of our production and delivery schedules as well as collect payments from customers in a timely manner
  • Staying Organized: Maintain detailed records of business transactions, update expense reports, keep internal systems current with customer and sales data, and manage account receivables
  • Connecting & Teaming Up: Collaborate with inside sales representatives to keep account activities and literature up to date
  • Managing Inventory Awareness: Track stock levels to align product availability with customer demand
  • Building Lasting Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with purchasing contracts that are rooted in trust and built for long-term collaboration

How To Thrive In This Role
  • Relevant Experience: 1-2 years of experience in restaurant sales, food sales, professional catering sales, and/or working as a Chef is highly desired and preferred
  • Positive Attitude: High energy, enthusiastic, a strong team player, and motivated to take responsibility and ensure successful outcomes despite obstacles
  • Relevant Skills: Excellent organizational skills, outstanding verbal and written communication skills used to develop a culture of participation and involvement, and ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects and initiatives
  • Self-Starter: Eager to ask questions and learn new skills quickly on the job
  • Education: College degree desired but not required
  • Leader: Able to foster a positive and innovative atmosphere that motivates others to take initiative and go above and beyond to achieve key objectives
  • Data-Driven: Comfortable with gathering facts and figures to monitor individual and team progress in a timely and accurate manner
  • Determined: Brings a sense of urgency to our fast-paced environment so that tight deadlines are met with short turnarounds

Minimum Qualifications
  • Must live within a commutable distance to the assigned geographic sales area
  • Must have a reliable form of transportation
  • Must have basic computer skills and understanding
  • Must have some proficiency in Microsoft Suite

Why Join The Chef’s Warehouse
  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission plan
  • Travel reimbursement
  • 401K Employer Matching
  • Paid holidays & vacations
  • Certified as a great place to work by the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors (Great Place To Work ®)

Our Values
  • C urious and Creative
    • Are you ready to challenge the status quo?
  • H ungry For Food and Results
    • Are you passionate about food and driven to deliver results?
  • E ntrepreneurial
    • Are you success-oriented and adaptable to ever-changing needs?
  • F oward Thinking and Flexible
    • Are you innovative and able to stay ahead of the competition?
  • S upportive Of Peers and Chefs
    • Are you eager to collaborate with and support your colleagues?
The above job description is not an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

Perks & Benefits
  • Paid Vacations, Paid Holidays
  • Health, Dental and Medical Benefits
  • Weekly pay
  • Life Insurance
  • 5% above cost for our high-quality food products
  • Employee discounts for travel and events
  • 401k
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

The Chefs' Warehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment. We are dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.

name: AI/ML Engineer Intern
text: About This Role Work directly on Pawanax's Pawa-Med™ Intelligence Engine — fine-tuning medical foundation models on African disease datasets, building RAG pipelines for clinical knowledge retrieval, and pushing the frontier of AI diagnostics on the continent. We are prioritizing builders who are deeply curious, mission-driven, and excited to grow fast while solving real African healthcare problems. What You'll Do Fine-tune LLMs (MedGemma, LLaMA, Mistral) on African clinical datasets Build and optimize RAG pipelines for medical knowledge retrieval Implement model quantization for edge/low-resource deployment Design evaluation benchmarks for African healthcare contexts Collaborate with clinicians on clinical validation of AI outputs Contribute to research papers and technical blog posts Requirements Currently pursuing BSc/MSc in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field Strong Python skills (PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers) Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) Understanding of NLP fundamentals and transformer architecture Passion for AI in healthcare and African market contexts Nice to Have Experience with medical NLP datasets (MIMIC, PubMed) Knowledge of RLHF or DPO alignment techniques Contributions to open-source ML projects Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar What You Get GPU compute credits Research publication support Mentorship from senior AI engineers Fast-track to full-time offer
html:
About This Role

Work directly on Pawanax's Pawa-Med™ Intelligence Engine — fine-tuning medical foundation models on African disease datasets, building RAG pipelines for clinical knowledge retrieval, and pushing the frontier of AI diagnostics on the continent.

We are prioritizing builders who are deeply curious, mission-driven, and excited to grow fast while solving real African healthcare problems.

What You'll Do

  • Fine-tune LLMs (MedGemma, LLaMA, Mistral) on African clinical datasets
  • Build and optimize RAG pipelines for medical knowledge retrieval
  • Implement model quantization for edge/low-resource deployment
  • Design evaluation benchmarks for African healthcare contexts
  • Collaborate with clinicians on clinical validation of AI outputs
  • Contribute to research papers and technical blog posts

Requirements
  • Currently pursuing BSc/MSc in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field
  • Strong Python skills (PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers)
  • Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT)
  • Understanding of NLP fundamentals and transformer architecture
  • Passion for AI in healthcare and African market contexts

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medical NLP datasets (MIMIC, PubMed)
  • Knowledge of RLHF or DPO alignment techniques
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar

What You Get

  • GPU compute credits
  • Research publication support
  • Mentorship from senior AI engineers
  • Fast-track to full-time offer

html:
OVERVIEW

Baran EPC, on behalf of BTN Group and its subsidiaries, is seeking an experienced, Microsoft-certified Lead Business Central Functional Consultant (MB-800).

In this role, you will champion the end-to-end implementation, configuration, and rollout of Dynamics 365 Business Central across the Group and its subsidiaries.

Following a successful deployment, you will transition into the platform's permanent internal custodian, taking full ownership of long-term system maintenance, continuous performance optimization, and day-to-day administration across the Group and its subsidiaries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Phase 1: Multi-Subsidiary Implementation & Rollout

a) Multi-Company Architecture: Design and configure a scalable Business Central environment where each subsidiary maintains its own independent books of accounts.

b) Consolidation Pipelines: Establish automated data workflows to deliver centralized, group-level consolidated financial reporting and intercompany transaction matching.

c) System Integration & Alignment: Lead the core deployment of Business Central modules, driving seamless data synchronization across Microsoft Project Operations and external third-party systems.

d) Data Migration & Testing: Direct data mapping, cleansing, and validation from legacy platforms, while defining the UAT strategy to guide business users through validation phases.

Phase 2: Post-Go-Live Maintenance & Administration

a) System Administration: Manage environment lifecycles, user licensing, security roles, and tenant permissions across the Group and its subsidiaries.

b) Release Management: Monitor Microsoft’s bi-annual major release waves and monthly cumulative updates. Conduct impact assessments and regression testing to prevent operational downtime.

c) Continuous Optimization: Audit platform performance, identify financial or workflow bottlenecks, and configure system enhancements as business operations evolve.

d) Advanced Solution Support: Provide Level 2/3 functional support, acting as the primary technical liaison with Microsoft support.

e) Reporting & Power Platform: Maintain and update Power BI dashboards, Jet Reports, and Power Automate workflows to ensure reliable corporate business intelligence.



Requirements

1. Certifications: Must hold valid Microsoft credentials for both core ecosystems:

a) Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant Associate (Exam MB-800) – Mandatory

b) Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (Exam PL-200) –Preferred

c) Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer Associate (Exam MB-820) – Preferred

2. Core Experience

a) Consulting History: Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on consulting or internal lead experience implementing Dynamics 365 Business Central.

b) Rollout Track Record: Proven experience leading at least 2 full-lifecycle, multi-subsidiary enterprise deployments of Business Central.

c) Financial Expertise: Strong proficiency navigating multi-currency corporate setups, group data consolidation pipelines, and complex localized chart of accounts setups.

d) Integration Knowledge: Direct experience working with systems connected via Microsoft Dataverse, standard ERP connectors, or API pipelines.




Benefits

  • Take ownership of a business-critical transformation initiative with visibility across senior leadership.
  • Build and shape enterprise systems that support multiple business units and international operations.
  • Accelerate your career through a blend of strategic leadership, innovation, and hands-on problem solving.
  • Expand your expertise within the Microsoft technology ecosystem while driving measurable business impact.

name: Plant Technician
text: Plant Operations and Equipment Maintenance Operate, monitor, and maintain plant machinery and equipment in accordance with operating procedures and manufacturer specifications. Conduct routine inspections of machinery, equipment, electrical/mechanical systems, and other plant installations. Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. Identify equipment defects, abnormalities, leaks, unusual noises, vibrations, overheating, and other potential faults. Carry out repairs and replacements of worn or defective components. Ensure machinery is properly lubricated, adjusted, calibrated, and maintained. Assist with installation, commissioning, modification, and decommissioning of plant equipment. Ensure plant equipment is maintained in a condition that supports continuous and efficient production. Fault Finding and Troubleshooting Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and other equipment-related faults. Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns and emergencies. Undertake corrective actions to restore equipment to operational condition. Escalate complex technical problems to the Maintenance/Plant Manager or relevant specialist. Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring equipment failures and recommend corrective measures. Maintain accurate records of breakdowns, repairs, and equipment performance. Preventive Maintenance Implement scheduled preventive maintenance activities in accordance with the plant maintenance plan. Inspect critical equipment and identify potential failures before they result in breakdowns. Maintain maintenance checklists and ensure scheduled tasks are completed within the required timelines. Recommend replacement or refurbishment of equipment and components where necessary. Support the development and improvement of preventive maintenance schedules. Safety and Compliance Comply with all occupational health and safety requirements, company policies, and plant procedures. Follow safe work procedures when working on machinery, electrical systems, moving equipment, and other hazardous plant installations. Apply Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures before undertaking maintenance or repair work where applicable. Properly use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Immediately report unsafe conditions, equipment hazards, incidents, near misses, and environmental risks. Participate in safety inspections, toolbox talks, emergency drills, and risk assessments. Ensure maintenance activities do not compromise the safety of employees, contractors, visitors, or plant operations. Production Support Work closely with production teams to ensure equipment availability and minimize production interruptions. Provide technical support during equipment start-up, shutdown, changeovers, and production activities. Respond to production-related equipment concerns and technical requests. Advise operators on correct equipment operation and basic maintenance requirements. Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, productivity, and efficiency. Spare Parts and Tools Identify and communicate requirements for spare parts, consumables, tools, and maintenance materials. Ensure tools and equipment are properly maintained, stored, and accounted for. Assist in maintaining appropriate stock levels of critical spare parts. Verify that replacement components meet required technical specifications. Minimize wastage and ensure responsible use of maintenance materials. Documentation and Reporting Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, inspection reports, and breakdown reports. Complete maintenance work orders and job cards accurately and on time. Record equipment readings, maintenance activities, faults, repairs, and replacement parts. Prepare reports on equipment performance, downtime, recurring faults, and maintenance activities as required. Ensure maintenance documentation is properly filed and readily available for reference and audits. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve plant reliability, efficiency, safety, and productivity. Participate in root-cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. Recommend modifications or improvements to machinery and plant systems. Support initiatives aimed at reducing equipment downtime, maintenance costs, energy consumption, and production losses. Keep up to date with relevant technical developments, equipment technologies, and maintenance practices. Housekeeping and Environmental Responsibilities Maintain a clean, organized, and safe maintenance work area. Ensure tools, equipment, and spare parts are stored appropriately after use. Dispose of used oils, lubricants, damaged components, and other maintenance waste in accordance with environmental requirements. Prevent and promptly report oil, chemical, fuel, or other hazardous-material spills. Support the plant's environmental management and sustainability initiatives. Requirements Minimum tertiary qualification - Diploma or Degree in Mechanical/Electrical Electromechanical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or in a relevant field. Trade Test certification. PLC/Automation certification. Certification / Knowledge of warehouse machinery, refrigeration systems, or facility equipment. Office clerical procedures. 3-5 years' experience in an automated manufacturing, processing, FMCG, cold-chain, or industrial environment with experience operating and maintaining production equipment – Avoline etc. Attention to detail Able to work under pressure and independently Time management Assertive, organized and proactive Leadership Skills Delivers high output and is deadline driven Ability to work in a fast-paced environment Knowledge of PLC-controlled equipment. Understanding of sensors, actuators, VFDs, and control panels.
html:
Plant Operations and Equipment Maintenance


  • Operate, monitor, and maintain plant machinery and equipment in accordance with operating procedures and manufacturer specifications.
  • Conduct routine inspections of machinery, equipment, electrical/mechanical systems, and other plant installations.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Identify equipment defects, abnormalities, leaks, unusual noises, vibrations, overheating, and other potential faults.
  • Carry out repairs and replacements of worn or defective components.
  • Ensure machinery is properly lubricated, adjusted, calibrated, and maintained.
  • Assist with installation, commissioning, modification, and decommissioning of plant equipment.
  • Ensure plant equipment is maintained in a condition that supports continuous and efficient production.

Fault Finding and Troubleshooting


  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and other equipment-related faults.
  • Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns and emergencies.
  • Undertake corrective actions to restore equipment to operational condition.
  • Escalate complex technical problems to the Maintenance/Plant Manager or relevant specialist.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring equipment failures and recommend corrective measures.
  • Maintain accurate records of breakdowns, repairs, and equipment performance.

Preventive Maintenance


  • Implement scheduled preventive maintenance activities in accordance with the plant maintenance plan.
  • Inspect critical equipment and identify potential failures before they result in breakdowns.
  • Maintain maintenance checklists and ensure scheduled tasks are completed within the required timelines.
  • Recommend replacement or refurbishment of equipment and components where necessary.
  • Support the development and improvement of preventive maintenance schedules.

Safety and Compliance


  • Comply with all occupational health and safety requirements, company policies, and plant procedures.
  • Follow safe work procedures when working on machinery, electrical systems, moving equipment, and other hazardous plant installations.
  • Apply Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures before undertaking maintenance or repair work where applicable.
  • Properly use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Immediately report unsafe conditions, equipment hazards, incidents, near misses, and environmental risks.
  • Participate in safety inspections, toolbox talks, emergency drills, and risk assessments.
  • Ensure maintenance activities do not compromise the safety of employees, contractors, visitors, or plant operations.

Production Support


  • Work closely with production teams to ensure equipment availability and minimize production interruptions.
  • Provide technical support during equipment start-up, shutdown, changeovers, and production activities.
  • Respond to production-related equipment concerns and technical requests.
  • Advise operators on correct equipment operation and basic maintenance requirements.
  • Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, productivity, and efficiency.

Spare Parts and Tools


  • Identify and communicate requirements for spare parts, consumables, tools, and maintenance materials.
  • Ensure tools and equipment are properly maintained, stored, and accounted for.
  • Assist in maintaining appropriate stock levels of critical spare parts.
  • Verify that replacement components meet required technical specifications.
  • Minimize wastage and ensure responsible use of maintenance materials.

Documentation and Reporting


  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, inspection reports, and breakdown reports.

text: Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world-class provider of multi-asset fintech products - from liquidity solutions to in-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility. Think finance is stuffy? Think again. We see Equiti as a new breed of broker, and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Finance department would like to welcome a detail-oriented Financial Accountant in our office in Nairobi, Kenya The Accountant is responsible for day-to-day tasks in the Accounts Payable team. Responsibilities Manage the full Accounts Payable cycle, including vendor onboarding, PR/PO processing, invoice verification, approvals, and payments. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely invoice approvals and payment execution. Maintain proper financial documentation and filing for audit readiness. Post invoices and related entries in SAP and perform supplier reconciliations. Prepare payable/receivable schedules and post required adjustments in SAP. Perform bank and vendor reconciliations. Update accruals and prepayment schedules as part of month‑end closing. Maintain the Fixed Assets Register, including additions, disposals, and depreciation. Support internal and external audits with required schedules and documentation. Execute additional finance tasks as assigned. Skills & Competencies Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data accurately. Solid financial and commercial acumen. Proficiency in computerized accounting systems, preferably SAP, and strong command of Microsoft Office applications. Strong planning and organizational skills with a clear commercial orientation. Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across teams. Sound understanding of accounting principles and financial management practices. Experience Requirements 4 years of professional experience in Financial Accounting. Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting CPA or ACCA professional qualification Perks Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more. The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include: Competitive salary package Performance-based bonus Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members Smart working options Employee wellness initiatives Personalized career development Company lunch in the office Regular company events With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences. Equiti is an equal opportunity employer. “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

name: Urban Development Experts
text: Urban Development Experts – Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 About NTU International A/S NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment. NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “ Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006 .” The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer . The contract is expected to start in January 2027 and will have an implementation period of 48 months . Experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance assignments globally, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific . We are seeking experienced professionals across a broad range of urban development, planning, infrastructure and sustainability disciplines to join our Urban Development Experts Talent Pool . Key Responsibilities Supporting the identification, preparation, appraisal and implementation of sustainable urban development projects and programmes. Conducting urban diagnostics, prefeasibility and feasibility studies, technical assessments, economic and financial analyses, and urban development studies. Supporting integrated urban planning, land-use planning and the preparation of urban development strategies and master plans. Supporting the development of smart, green, inclusive, safe and climate-resilient cities . Advising public authorities on urban policies, regulatory frameworks, institutional arrangements and urban governance reforms. Supporting the preparation of urban investment pipelines aligned with Global Gateway and European Green Deal priorities . Integrating sustainable urban mobility and accessibility considerations into urban development planning. Supporting urban regeneration, public space development, nature-based solutions and green infrastructure. Integrating climate change adaptation and mitigation, disaster risk reduction, environmental sustainability and resilience into urban investments. Supporting socially inclusive urban development, including gender equality, accessibility and human rights considerations. Conducting economic and financial assessments and supporting the identification of appropriate financing mechanisms, including private sector participation and PPPs. Supporting infrastructure maintenance, asset management and life-cycle approaches to urban infrastructure. Contributing to institutional strengthening, knowledge creation, training and capacity-building activities. Facilitating coordination between municipal and national authorities, EU Delegations, IFIs, private sector stakeholders, civil society and development partners. Requirements Minimum 5 years of professional experience in urban development, urban planning, municipal infrastructure or related sectors, with expertise in one or more of the following areas: Integrated urban planning and sustainable urban development; Urban and regional planning; Urban regeneration and neighbourhood development; Sustainable urban mobility and accessibility; Smart cities and urban digitalisation; Green cities, green infrastructure and nature-based solutions; Climate-resilient urban development and climate adaptation; Urban environmental management and decarbonisation; Disaster risk reduction and urban resilience; Municipal infrastructure and urban services; Public spaces and inclusive urban design; Land-use planning and spatial development; Urban governance, policy and institutional reform; Social inclusion, gender equality and accessibility in urban development; Urban economics and municipal finance; Urban infrastructure investment planning and project preparation; Public-private partnerships and private sector participation in urban development; Infrastructure asset management and maintenance; Monitoring and evaluation of urban development programmes. Experience in international technical assistance, donor-funded and/or IFI-financed projects is highly desirable. Professional experience in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and/or Asia and the Pacific will be considered a strong asset. Familiarity with Global Gateway, the European Green Deal, G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment, sustainable urban development frameworks and international good practices is advantageous. Experience working with municipalities, national authorities, urban agencies, IFIs, development partners, civil society and/or private sector stakeholders is desirable. Strong analytical, coordination, stakeholder engagement and reporting skills. Language Requirements Excellent command of English is required. Knowledge of French and/or Spanish will be considered a strong asset depending on the assignment. Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
html:
Urban Development Experts – Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2


About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.


NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”


The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer.


The contract is expected to start in January 2027 and will have an implementation period of 48 months. Experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance assignments globally, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific.


We are seeking experienced professionals across a broad range of urban development, planning, infrastructure and sustainability disciplines to join our Urban Development Experts Talent Pool.


Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation, appraisal and implementation of sustainable urban development projects and programmes.
  • Conducting urban diagnostics, prefeasibility and feasibility studies, technical assessments, economic and financial analyses, and urban development studies.
  • Supporting integrated urban planning, land-use planning and the preparation of urban development strategies and master plans.
  • Supporting the development of smart, green, inclusive, safe and climate-resilient cities.
  • Advising public authorities on urban policies, regulatory frameworks, institutional arrangements and urban governance reforms.
  • Supporting the preparation of urban investment pipelines aligned with Global Gateway and European Green Deal priorities.
  • Integrating sustainable urban mobility and accessibility considerations into urban development planning.
  • Supporting urban regeneration, public space development, nature-based solutions and green infrastructure.
  • Integrating climate change adaptation and mitigation, disaster risk reduction, environmental sustainability and resilience into urban investments.
  • Supporting socially inclusive urban development, including gender equality, accessibility and human rights considerations.
  • Conducting economic and financial assessments and supporting the identification of appropriate financing mechanisms, including private sector participation and PPPs.
  • Supporting infrastructure maintenance, asset management and life-cycle approaches to urban infrastructure.
  • Contributing to institutional strengthening, knowledge creation, training and capacity-building activities.
  • Facilitating coordination between municipal and national authorities, EU Delegations, IFIs, private sector stakeholders, civil society and development partners.


Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in urban development, urban planning, municipal infrastructure or related sectors, with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Integrated urban planning and sustainable urban development;

Urban and regional planning;

Urban regeneration and neighbourhood development;

Sustainable urban mobility and accessibility;

Smart cities and urban digitalisation;

Green cities, green infrastructure and nature-based solutions;

Climate-resilient urban development and climate adaptation;

Urban environmental management and decarbonisation;

Disaster risk reduction and urban resilience;

Municipal infrastructure and urban services;

Public spaces and inclusive urban design;

Land-use planning and spatial development;

Urban governance, policy and institutional reform;

Social inclusion, gender equality and accessibility in urban development;

Urban economics and municipal finance;

Urban infrastructure investment planning and project preparation;

Public-private partnerships and private sector participation in urban development;

Infrastructure asset management and maintenance;

Monitoring and evaluation of urban development programmes.

  • Experience in international technical assistance, donor-funded and/or IFI-financed projects is highly desirable.
  • Professional experience in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and/or Asia and the Pacific will be considered a strong asset.
  • Familiarity with Global Gateway, the European Green Deal, G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment, sustainable urban development frameworks and international good practices is advantageous.
  • Experience working with municipalities, national authorities, urban agencies, IFIs, development partners, civil society and/or private sector stakeholders is desirable.
  • Strong analytical, coordination, stakeholder engagement and reporting skills.


Language Requirements

  • Excellent command of English is required.
  • Knowledge of French and/or Spanish will be considered a strong asset depending on the assignment.


Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
