name: Administrative Officer.
text: Duties Develop and execute methods and procedures for improving organizational structure and allocating, monitoring, analyzing, evaluating, and reporting human resource and budgetary utilization. Provide advice to managers and resource management staff on HR and budget matters. Execute the annual budget for assigned programs—prepare justification statements, research and document financial data, and compile expenditure information. Perform detailed analysis of expenditure and obligation information to ensure adequacy of funds and prevent over-obligation. Develop and compile statistical financial reports pertaining to obligations and expenditures. Oversee collection of data for regular and special budget reports (e.g., monthly status of funds, projected and committed spending). Work with program staff to develop implementation plans for adequate staffing, budgetary, and operational projections. Coordinate and oversee assessment of internal operating procedures for resource control. Review and analyze financial operations—budgetary and contracting requirements, travel and per diem costs, and recommend changes in reporting forms, policies, and procedures. Develop standard operating procedures for resource management activities (position management, staffing, workload metrics, assignment coverage, temporary travel management). Serve as approving official for procurements via USDA purchase card program—oversee procurement of supplies, equipment, services, and equipment maintenance/repairs. Audit requisitions to ensure required justifications are present and adequate. Develop and initiate new or revised day-to-day operating procedures for resource management. Requirements Conditions of employment You must be a US Citizen or US National. Males born after 12/31/1959 must be Selective Service registered or exempt. Subject to satisfactory adjudication of background investigation and/or fingerprint check. May be required to successfully complete a probationary or trial period, unless previously served. Refer to the Next Steps section for more information. Direct Deposit: Per Public Law 104-134 all Federal employees are required to have federal payments made by direct deposit to their financial institution. If you are newly hired, the documentation you present for purposes of completing the Department Homeland Security (DHS) Form I-9 on your entry-on-duty date will be verified through the DHS "E-VERIFY" system. Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/. False statements or responses on a resume or application can jeopardize employment and may be grounds for disciplinary action, including removal from Federal service. If you are selected, you may need to complete a Declaration for Federal Employment (OF-306) prior to being appointed to determine suitability for Federal employment and to authorize a background investigation. Qualifications Applicants must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of the announcement including time-in-grade restrictions, specialized experience and/or education, as defined below. Time in Grade : Current federal employees applying for a promotion opportunity must meet the time in grade requirement of 52 weeks of service at the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression for the position being filled. Specialized Experience: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-12 level) that demonstrates the statements below: Prepared budget justification materials and applied USDA financial systems to research and monitor financial data. Worked with other management officials to develop budget estimates and goals. Reviewed available funding and adjusted budget estimates to prevent over-obligation and maintain fiscal integrity. Compiled and analyzed historical statistical and narrative data relating to budgetary planning to determine the impact of higher level decisions and possible organizational impact. Applying federal fiscal law, OMB guidance or agency budget procedures to assigned budget tasks, including reviewing financial operating plans or budget documents for conformance with appropriation law and agency policy requirements. Tracked and monitored obligations, expenditures, or allotment balances for assigned agency program accounts, preparing routine variance reports and identifying discrepancies for potential compliance issues and preparing budget execution documents, budget allotments, and budget allocations. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Education There is no education substitute or requirement for this position at the GS-13 grade level. Additional information Career Transition Assistance Plan (CTAP), Reemployment Priority List (RPL), or Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan (ICTAP): Visit the For more information on applying under special hiring authorities such as the Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA), 30 percent disabled veterans, certain military spouses, Schedule A Disabled, etc., explore the different Hiring Paths on the Reasonable Accommodation (RA) Requests: If you believe you have a disability (i.e., physical or mental), covered by the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 as amended that would interfere with completing the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments, you will be granted the opportunity to request a RA in your online application. Requests for RA for the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments and appropriate supporting documentation for RA must be received prior to starting the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments. Decisions on requests for RA are made on a case-by-case basis. If you meet the minimum qualifications of the position, after notification of the adjudication of your request, you will receive an email invitation to complete the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments, based on your adjudication decision. You must complete all assessments within 48 hours of receiving the URL to access the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments if you received the link after the close of the announcement. To determine if you need a RA, please review the Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution. A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

name: Gender & Social Inclusion Officer
text: IFAD is a United Nations specialized agency dedicated to reducing rural poverty and hunger through investments in smallholder agriculture, food systems, climate resilience, and the empowerment of women, youth, and vulnerable rural communities. Based within IFAD's Environment, Climate, Gender and Social Inclusion (ECG) Division, the Gender & Social Inclusion Officer will provide technical expertise to integrate gender equality and social inclusion across IFAD-funded programmes in East and Southern Africa. Key Responsibilities Advise on gender and social inclusion during project design, supervision, and implementation. Support programme development, knowledge management, monitoring and evaluation, and partnership building. Strengthen integration of gender, youth, disability, and social inclusion aspects across rural development initiatives. Deliver capacity-building and technical support to regional IFAD teams. Produce analytical reports and contribute to knowledge products and best-practice dissemination. Undertake regional travel across East and Southern Africa as required. Requirements Master's degree in Gender Studies, Social Sciences, Sociology, Economics, Rural Development, Human or Development Geography, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in gender equality and social inclusion within rural development programmes. Strong expertise in the inclusion of women, youth, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. Experience supporting development projects, preferably investment programmes. Excellent analytical, reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Fluency in English required; working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese is an asset. UNV Benefits The assignment includes the standard UN Volunteer package, including a monthly living allowance (MLA), insurance, leave, and other entitlements according to UNV Conditions of Service. Current MLA: US$ 2,765 to US$ 3,215 Check out UNV's Entitlement Calculator on UVP , the Unified Volunteering Platform, and learn more. Application deadline: 9 September 2026

If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: ToRTMC0005614.pdf

Minimum Requirements
  • Education: University degree in Public Health, Mental Health, International Humanitarian Affairs, Data and Evaluation or related field, with strong experience in applying marketing, communications or journalism, in mental health

Remarks

If the TOR or financial proposal documents are not visible on certain recruitment platforms, please visit our official page Vacancies | UNICEF Careers.

html:
Job Title: Technical Expert

Term: 10 months

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Division: TAM (Technical Account Management)

Reports to: Technical Account Management Lead

Relevant experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in payment gateways, acquiring or technical project delivery.

Mandatory requirements: Strong understanding of payment approvals flows, digital commerce, merchant integrations, rules on declines, fraud rules.

PURPOSE OF JOB

The objective of this role is to support Issuing Clients to uplift their Card-not-Present Approval Rates by identifying, diagnosing and solving key addressable decline reasons. The candidate would work closely with issuers and their acquirers in providing end-to-end technical and operational support in the authorization space.

The TAM Deploy resource will coordinate addressable decline recommendations, manage technical support requests, and ensure efficient delivery and adoption of approval optimization by clients.

The resource will apply intermediate, practical knowledge to support service delivery, ensure operational excellence, and contribute to positive customer outcomes.


TASKS

Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The deploy resource will:

  • Analyze the key decline reasons for the selected markets, identifying at a customer level required actions to optimize approval rates
  • Support the technology and operational relationship with assigned customers, ensuring the optimization actions are undertaken at the customers
  • Act as the primary point of contact for authorization optimization activities, coordinating closely with internal teams and Client stakeholders to initiate projects and follow up on onboarding requirements.
  • Provide the ground deployment and project support as required, including logging requests, tracking actions, and providing regular status updates to the Client.
  • Conduct regular review meetings with the Client to track open onboarding projects, incidents, and technical tickets.
  • Coordinate with the Client's technical teams to ensure timely and high-quality support for authorization optimization

KPIs

  • Increase in CNP approval rates
  • Reduction in CNP decline amounts

Knowledge and Experience

  • Strong understanding of authorization flows
  • Hands-on experience supporting issuers to optimize customer experience
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced client environment
  • Experience working with cross-functional technical, operational, and business stakeholders

Mandatory Skills

  • Deep understanding of card payments, processing, and architecture.
  • Operations excellence
  • Project management
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder‑management skills

We take a deep understanding of people, culture and trends and turn it into ideas that spark conversation and shape how our brands are experienced around the world. From defining brand strategy to launching campaigns that people remember, the work here influences how we show up in the moments that matter. You’ll be part of a team that’s curious, collaborative and always looking ahead, reimagining our brands for today while building what comes next. This includes full ownership of the Marketing Business Plan (MBP)—from planning and budgeting to execution and performance tracking. Role Dimensions Financial Accountability ( Budget/Revenue) Deliver volume, revenue and profitability targets Monitor market share and competitor activity and relevant marketing investment spend Leadership Responsibilities Strategic & MBP Leadership: Own and drive the Marketing Business Plan (MBP), setting brand direction and ensuring delivery of growth, profitability, and brand equity targets at Kenya Breweries Limited. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Influence: Lead through influence by aligning internal teams and external partners to deliver strong, consistent in-market execution in a competitive landscape including AB InBev. Execution & Performance Ownership: Ensure excellence in campaign execution, track performance against KPIs, and take accountability for results through data-driven decision-making and continuous optimization Top Accountabilities Marketing Business Plan (MBP) Management Develop and own the annual MBP aligned to business objectives Define brand growth targets (volume, revenue, market share) Identify key consumer segments and growth opportunities Manage and optimize A&P (Advertising & Promotion) budgets Track, analyze, and report MBP performance against KPIs Adjust strategies based on in-market performance and insights Brand Strategy & Development Define and maintain brand positioning and identity Build long-term brand equity and differentiation Lead innovation pipeline (new products, packaging, variants) Ensure consistency across all consumer touchpoints Campaign Planning & Execution Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns (ATL, BTL, Digital) Lead creative development with agencies Drive consumer engagement through activations and experiences Ensure excellence in execution across channels Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management Collaborate with: Sales (trade execution) Finance (budget control & ROI tracking) Supply Chain (product availability) External agencies (creative, media, digital) Ensure alignment on brand priorities and execution plans Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field 3–7 years’ experience in FMCG/consumer marketing Proven experience in brand management and campaign execution Experience managing budgets and delivering business results Skills & Experience Strategic thinking and planning Financial acumen and budget management Strong analytical and data interpretation skills Consumer insight development Project and stakeholder management Creativity and innovation mindset Working with Us Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. Job Description

About the Function:

Marketing is where our brands show up in culture and stay there.

This is where creativity meets insight. We take a deep understanding of people, culture and trends and turn it into ideas that spark conversation and shape how our brands are experienced around the world.

From defining brand strategy to launching campaigns that people remember, the work here influences how we show up in the moments that matter.

You’ll be part of a team that’s curious, collaborative and always looking ahead, reimagining our brands for today while building what comes next.

Purpose Of Role

The Brand Manager is responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and long-term equity of assigned brands through the development and execution of effective marketing strategies. This includes full ownership of the Marketing Business Plan (MBP)—from planning and budgeting to execution and performance tracking.

Role Dimensions

Financial Accountability (Budget/Revenue)
  • Deliver volume, revenue and profitability targets
  • Monitor market share and competitor activity and relevant marketing investment spend

  • Develop and own the annual MBP aligned to business objectives
  • Define brand growth targets (volume, revenue, market share)
  • Identify key consumer segments and growth opportunities
  • Manage and optimize A&P (Advertising & Promotion) budgets
  • Track, analyze, and report MBP performance against KPIs
  • Adjust strategies based on in-market performance and insights

Brand Strategy & Development
  • Define and maintain brand positioning and identity
  • Build long-term brand equity and differentiation
  • Lead innovation pipeline (new products, packaging, variants)
  • Ensure consistency across all consumer touchpoints

Campaign Planning & Execution
  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns (ATL, BTL, Digital)
  • Lead creative development with agencies

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

    • External agencies (creative, media, digital)
  • Ensure alignment on brand priorities and execution plans
Qualifications

  • 3–7 years’ experience in FMCG/consumer marketing
  • Proven experience in brand management and campaign execution
  • Experience managing budgets and delivering business results

  • Financial acumen and budget management
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills
  • Consumer insight development
  • Project and stakeholder management
  • Creativity and innovation mindset

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

At Stego, we believe work should be more than a place you go – it should be a community where you thrive. About The Job

Interested in joining a growing organization with a driven, supportive, growth-minded culture? Are you passionate about leveraging your communication skills and your relationships with architects and engineering firms? Looking for a team that recognizes your contributions and cares about your development and success? This may be the job for you! Check out the details below and apply today!

JOB TITLE: Specifications Sales Account Executive

EMPLOYMENT STATUS: Full Time, Exempt

LOCATION (Remote within specific area): Employee's Home Office within the West Region*

  • Currently expected to be overseeing and located within the Western United States

HOURS & TIME ZONE: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm Local Time (PT or MT time zone)

PAY RANGE: Annualized salary reasonably expected to be $85,000 - $115,000 based on location, experience, and education, plus incentive compensation, monthly Auto Allowance (annualized value of $10,200), AAA membership, Life Insurance, Company contribution to health insurance premiums, and Lifestyle Spending Account (annualized value $1,500).

BENEFITS: Eligible employees may participate in a variety of benefit programs (some of which are available only upon reaching certain time-based milestones), which may include, without limitation, health insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, health reimbursement and flexible spending accounts, 401(k) with a company match offering, life insurance, sick leave, parental leave, and vacation. Stego also offers early-out Fridays at 3pm in 2026 (Friday Holiday Hours).

Role Purpose

The purpose of the Specifications Account Executive role is to influence and secure specifications for Stego brands across customer account and construction project opportunities, in contribution to the achievement of the priorities and objectives of the Specifications Subdivision, Pipeline Development Division, and Company.

What You'll Own (essential Functions)
  • GOAL ACHIEVEMENT:
    • Collaborate with the Vice President of Pipeline Development to identify, develop, and implement strategic plans for the achievement of individual and Specifications Subdivision priorities and objectives
    • Ensure internal cross-collaboration and utilization of Company resources to achieve shared objectives
    • Ensure data-driven post-analysis of achievements and opportunities for growth using KPIs/BI tools
    • Meaningfully contribute to the achievement of Specifications Subdivision priorities and objectives through effective processes, critical thinking, problem solving, and strategy implementation, in furtherance of the priorities and objectives of the Pipeline Development Division and the Company

  • SPECIFICATIONS RESPONSIBILITIES:
    • Develop and execute strategic and tactical plans for promoting Stego products and influencing and securing specifications that strategically position Stego products as the standard choice for architects, engineers, consultants, and others in the design community
    • Engage with and influence design professionals, consulting and supporting them with technical expertise and specification services
    • Create demand for Stego products, strengthening brand presence in the design and construction communities, and ensuring opportunities for downstream sales pull-through
    • Conduct engaging, compelling, and technically sound virtual and in-person seminars/webinars and meetings, and communicate by phone and email, with architecture and engineering firms to market and create demand for Stego products across multiple brands
    • Identify, evaluate, and track construction projects and customer accounts with potential for Stego products through effective processes, critical thinking, problem solving, and strategy implementation
    • Analyze specification trends and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities and inform brand and demand creation strategies
    • Collaborate with Lead Generation, Customer Development, and Sales teams to continually nurture relationships and opportunities, ensuring specification pull-through
    • Develop, manage, and maintain strong working relationships with key industry stakeholders to strengthen market presence and Stego brand loyalty
    • Actively and consistently utilize Stego’s CRM and other internal resources per Company policy to identify, develop, and maximize specification opportunities and relationships with target accounts by tracking specification activities, account engagements (activities), and construction project progress

  • CUSTOMER SERVICE & INDUSTRY INVOLVEMENT:
    • Serve as a Stego brand ambassador, ensuring consistent positioning, messaging, and value communication across all customer touchpoints
    • Field inbound inquiries from architectural and design customers, including technical and product application questions, as needed
    • Participate in Stego regional specification “blitzes” and represent Stego at key regional and national trade shows and customer and industry events (including A/E and national conferences) to expand brand visibility and influence
    • Actively engage in relevant industry groups and develop and maintain strong working relationships with customers and others in the industry

  • COMPANY CULTURE & CORE VALUES:
    • Build strong working relationships and collaborate with other Pipeline Development Division and Sales Division team members, and all Stego Employees
    • Establish the Specifications Subdivision as a respected and collaborative Company resource
    • Support and contribute to the culture and atmosphere of the Specifications subdivision, in alignment with Stego’s Core Values
Required Skills, Traits & Competencies
  • Excellent presentation, networking, and oral and written communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking, planning, problem solving, and strategy implementation skills
  • High emotional intelligence
  • Highly motivated, reliable, and trustworthy with strong follow-through skills
  • Ability to thrive in a team environment (strong interpersonal skills)

Education, Experience, Competencies
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (required)
  • Minimum of 3 years of architectural sales experience (required)
  • 5+ years of sales experience (preferred)
  • Demonstrated track record of meaningfully contributing to profitability and market share growth (required)
  • Construction, manufacturing, design, or technical experience (preferred)
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs and Salesforce (strongly preferred)

Physical Reqirements
  • Ability to communicate frequently on a daily basis by phone or video conference
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards and remain in a stationary position to work on a computer for prolonged periods
  • Physical ability to travel to attend customer, team, and industry meetings and events

Work Environment
  • Work is performed in an office environment and on location with customers (which may include offices, warehouses/yards, and construction sites)

Travel Required
  • Ability to travel to and attend team and Company meetings and events, including days, nights and overnight stays (approximately 15% of the time).
  • Ability to travel to and attend customer meetings and events, including days, nights, and overnight stays (approximately 25% of the time).
  • Ability to travel to and attend industry meetings, conferences, and events, including days, nights, and overnight stays (approximately 15% of the time).

Process Notice

It is important for Stego to be thorough in our vetting and interview process to make sure the position is the right fit for both parties. Please note that it may take up to a couple of weeks of vetting and narrowing down candidates before we begin the formal interview process. Following initial vetting of applications, you may be invited to interview with several Stego team members. Initial interviews will be done virtually, and later interviews may be done in person. We appreciate your understanding and patience, and we will endeavor to respect your time and investment as much as possible.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

We have received reports of individuals falsely claiming to recruit on behalf of Stego. All legitimate openings are listed at https://stego-industries.breezy.hr/. Our recruiters communicate only through email addresses ending in @ stegoindustries.com. We do not make job offers without completing our established interview process, and we will never ask candidates to purchase equipment, cash a check, send money, or provide banking information before verified hire and onboarding. If you receive a suspicious communication, please contact Careers@ stegoindustries.com.

name: Consultant - Strengthening Distress Reporting Mechanisms
text: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations, and as the leading UN agency in the field of migration, works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to ensuring a workplace where all employees can thrive professionally, while working towards harnessing the full potential of migration. Read more about IOM's workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Project Context and Scope The Better Regional Migration Management (BRMM) programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) of the Government of the United Kingdom, Better Regional Migration Management (BRMM) Programme, aims to advance safe, orderly, and regular labour migration across the East and Horn of Africa (EHoA). It seeks to do so by strengthening skills-to-employment systems, promoting fair and ethical recruitment in line with international labour standards, and enhancing the protection of migrant workers throughout the migration cycle. Youth in Kenya continue to seek migration opportunities amid limited access to reliable, timely, and verified information on safe and regular pathways. Job Description

Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations, and as the leading UN agency in the field of migration, works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to ensuring a workplace where all employees can thrive professionally, while working towards harnessing the full potential of migration. Read more about IOM's workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Project Context and Scope

The Better Regional Migration Management (BRMM) programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) of the Government of the United Kingdom, Better Regional Migration Management (BRMM) Programme, aims to advance safe, orderly, and regular labour migration across the East and Horn of Africa (EHoA). It seeks to do so by strengthening skills-to-employment systems, promoting fair and ethical recruitment in line with international labour standards, and enhancing the protection of migrant workers throughout the migration cycle.

Youth in Kenya continue to seek migration opportunities amid limited access to reliable, timely, and verified information on safe and regular pathways. Existing support points—such as hotlines, migrant resource centers, and digital platforms—are underutilized or constrained by fragmented referral systems, weak feedback mechanisms, and inconsistent case management procedures.

To address these gaps, this consultancy will strengthen the availability and quality of migration information and services at points where young people already seek support, by enhancing hotline systems, feedback loops, and coordinated referral pathways.

The consultancy will support the strengthening access to safe and regular migration pathways for vulnerable youth by improving the effectiveness, responsiveness, and coordination of hotline, feedback, and referral systems.

Organizational Department / Unit to which the Consultant is contributing

This assignment falls under the Labour Mobility Division at IOM Kenya, particularly under the (BRMM) Programme. Under the overall guidance of the Chief of Mission and direct supervision of the Head of Programme and Policy Development, and coordination with the National Programme Officer, the consultant will work closely with the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection, National Employment Authority (NEA), and any other relevant stakeholders involved.

Responsibilities

Tasks to be performed under this contract

The Consultant Will Be Responsible For
  • Developing the SOPs and response channels for the feedback mechanism
  • Organize workshop to Upgrade or refine distress forms and hotline forms to capture key information (case type, location, urgency, referral needs etc)
  • Develop SOP on Feedback and Case Closure Mechanisms
  • Capacity Building for Hotline and Case Management Staff
  • Establish regular coordination channels between hotline managers and referral partners to ensure timely responses
  • Capacity building of the officers at KLMRC, TVETs etc on labour migration policies, procedures, Ethical recruitment and rights-based counselling
  • Development and Dissemination of IEC Materials

Performance indicators for the evaluation of results
  • Inception Report outlining the consultancy approach, work plan within 2 weeks of the contract start.
  • Review existing hotline and distress reporting mechanisms (forms, digital tools, workflows) with recommendations
  • Comprehensive Mapping Report Map current referral pathways, response actors, and service gaps
  • Developed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for: Case intake, triage, and prioritization; Referral and escalation processes; Feedback provision to beneficiaries; Case tracking and closure mechanisms (ensuring that the SOPs are aligned with safeguarding, data protection, and ethical standards)
  • Organizing and facilitation of multi-stakeholder workshop to refine existing distress and hotline forms
  • Capacity building of the KLMRC/NEA officers on Design and deliver training for hotline operators and case management staff on: SOP implementation; Case handling and documentation; Referral coordination and follow-up; Safeguarding and ethical communication
  • Develop protocols for information-sharing and timely response management between hotline teams and referral partners (e.g. government agencies, service providers, NGOs)
  • Final Consultancy Report summarizing findings, referral pathways, key recommendations, and an implementation roadmap for strengthening enhancing hotline systems, feedback loops, and coordinated referral pathways.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education
  • Advanced degree in migration, development, social sciences, or related field.
  • Proven experience in migration programming, hotline systems, or case management/referral mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in SOP development and capacity building.
  • Strong understanding of safeguarding, data protection, and ethical service delivery.
  • Experience in Kenya or the East and Horn of Africa region is highly desirable.
  • Fluency in English and Swahili

Experience
  • S trong management capability and experience
  • Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations, and private sector entities
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent report writing skills
  • Excellent computer skills

Skills
  • Strong management capability and experience
  • Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations, and private sector entities
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent report writing skills
  • Excellent computer skills

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.
  • Core Competencies – behavioural indicators
  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Application Process

Interested Candidates Should Submit The Following
  • Technical proposal outlining approach and methodology.
  • Financial proposal.
  • CV of proposed consultant
  • Samples of similar work

Notes

IOM covers Consultants against occupational accidents and illnesses under the Compensation Plan (CP), free of charge, for the duration of the consultancy. IOM does not provide evacuation or medical insurance for reasons related to non-occupational accidents and illnesses. Consultants are responsible for their own medical insurance for non-occupational accident or illness and will be required to provide written proof of such coverage before commencing work.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

name: Technical Expert
text: Job Title: Technical Expert Term: 10 months Location: Nairobi, Kenya Division: TAM (Technical Account Management) Reports to: Technical Account Management Lead Relevant experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in payment gateways, acquiring or technical project delivery. Mandatory requirements: Strong understanding of payment approvals flows, digital commerce, merchant integrations, rules on declines, fraud rules. PURPOSE OF JOB The objective of this role is to support Issuing Clients to uplift their Card-not-Present Approval Rates by identifying, diagnosing and solving key addressable decline reasons. The candidate would work closely with issuers and their acquirers in providing end-to-end technical and operational support in the authorization space. The TAM Deploy resource will coordinate addressable decline recommendations, manage technical support requests, and ensure efficient delivery and adoption of approval optimization by clients. TASKS Core Responsibilities And Accountabilities The deploy resource will: Analyze the key decline reasons for the selected markets, identifying at a customer level required actions to optimize approval rates Support the technology and operational relationship with assigned customers, ensuring the optimization actions are undertaken at the customers Act as the primary point of contact for authorization optimization activities, coordinating closely with internal teams and Client stakeholders to initiate projects and follow up on onboarding requirements. Provide the ground deployment and project support as required, including logging requests, tracking actions, and providing regular status updates to the Client. Conduct regular review meetings with the Client to track open onboarding projects, incidents, and technical tickets. Coordinate with the Client's technical teams to ensure timely and high-quality support for authorization optimization KPIs Increase in CNP approval rates Reduction in CNP decline amounts Knowledge And Experience Strong understanding of authorization flows Hands-on experience supporting issuers to optimize customer experience Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced client environment Experience working with cross-functional technical, operational, and business stakeholders Mandatory Skills Deep understanding of card payments, processing, and architecture. Operations excellence Project management Strong technical troubleshooting and problem‑solving capabilities Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder‑management skills

Job Title: Technical Expert

Term: 10 months

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Division: TAM (Technical Account Management)

Reports to: Technical Account Management Lead

Relevant experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in payment gateways, acquiring or technical project delivery.

Mandatory requirements: Strong understanding of payment approvals flows, digital commerce, merchant integrations, rules on declines, fraud rules.

PURPOSE OF JOB

The objective of this role is to support Issuing Clients to uplift their Card-not-Present Approval Rates by identifying, diagnosing and solving key addressable decline reasons. The candidate would work closely with issuers and their acquirers in providing end-to-end technical and operational support in the authorization space.

The TAM Deploy resource will coordinate addressable decline recommendations, manage technical support requests, and ensure efficient delivery and adoption of approval optimization by clients.

The resource will apply intermediate, practical knowledge to support service delivery, ensure operational excellence, and contribute to positive customer outcomes.

TASKS

Core Responsibilities And Accountabilities

The deploy resource will:
  • Analyze the key decline reasons for the selected markets, identifying at a customer level required actions to optimize approval rates
  • Support the technology and operational relationship with assigned customers, ensuring the optimization actions are undertaken at the customers
  • Act as the primary point of contact for authorization optimization activities, coordinating closely with internal teams and Client stakeholders to initiate projects and follow up on onboarding requirements.

  • Increase in CNP approval rates
  • Reduction in CNP decline amounts


Knowledge And Experience
  • Strong understanding of authorization flows
  • Hands-on experience supporting issuers to optimize customer experience
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced client environment
  • Experience working with cross-functional technical, operational, and business stakeholders


Mandatory Skills
  • Deep understanding of card payments, processing, and architecture.
  • Operations excellence
  • Project management
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder‑management skills

name: Innovative Financing Global Advisor – Nairobi, KENYA
text: Starting position: 1.11.2026 Type of contract: National contract in accordance with Kenyan labour legislation Duration : 12 months Rate of activity : 100% Place of work : Nairobi, Kenya Eligibility: Only candidates eligible to work in Kenya will be considered Deadline for applications: Terre des hommes does not set a deadline for applications for this position, recruitment is open until the position is filled. Terre des hommes (Tdh) : The Terre des hommes Foundation (Tdh), with headquarters in Lausanne and an office in Zurich, is the leading Swiss child rights organisation with more than 2000 employees worldwide. We stand together with children to uphold their rights, protect their lives and improve their well-being. We achieve this through innovative programmes focused on health, migration and access to justice, specially designed to have a positive and sustainable impact. This position is hosted by Tdh in Kenya. Context : The Innovative Financing Global Advisor will support Terre des hommes’ (Tdh) new global initiative on innovative financing, established to diversify funding sources and strengthen long-term organizational future readiness. In alignment with the global institutional initiative, the Advisor will drive learning, scoping, partnership development, and early implementation of innovative financing approaches relevant to Tdh’s mission, programs, and geographical presence. The role serves as Tdh’s internal engine for financial innovation: building capacity, coordinating cross-departmental work, engaging external experts, and designing pilot initiatives that will contribute to the next global strategy. Key Responsibilities Strategic Development and Leadership Support the delivery of Tdh’s innovative financing roadmap in specific contexts and programs/thematic areas of Tdh. Conduct strategic analysis of market trends, donor shifts, and emerging financing models in the humanitarian and development sectors. Translate complex financing concepts into actionable opportunities for Tdh. Landscape Analysis & Knowledge Building Conduct and update a comprehensive mapping of financing instruments, actors, and mechanisms relevant to Tdh in specific countries, regions, thematic areas/programs. Facilitate internal learning through workshops, expert briefings, and capacity-building sessions across departments and regions. Identify internal capacity gaps (finance, risk, compliance, legal, MEAL) and propose strengthening measures. Partnership Development Engage external experts, donors, DFIs, financial institutions, consultancies, and academic partners to support the initiatives of Tdh in the field. Build Tdh’s credibility in the innovative financing ecosystem, representing the organization in relevant forums when required. Explore opportunities to join existing mechanisms or consortia. Pilot Design and Early Implementation Coordinate the design of pilot(s) in strategic domains (climate, health, child protection, migration, etc.). Formalize technical partnerships needed for implementation. Document early lessons learned to inform strategy development for 2028+. **The full Job Description will be shared with shortlisted candidates.** Profile : Education : Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Development, Public Policy, Business Administration, or related field Specific training in blended finance, impact investing, or development finance. Experience / Skills : Proven experience (7+ years) in innovative financing, humanitarian, and development finance. Track record in working with financial mechanisms and instruments used in the humanitarian and development sectors. Proven experience in working with multilateral development banks or consulting companies focused on humanitarian and development finance. Experience in working in cross-functional teams and working with financial, legal, and programmatic stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to translate market intelligence into strategy and actionable proposals. Excellent analytical, project management, and communication skills. Knowledge of INGO operational challenges and realities is an asset. Experience engaging external experts, donors, DFIs, or private‑sector actors. Solid knowledge of impact measurement design and reporting. Languages : Fluency in English (required) Working knowledge of French (an asset) IT knowledge : Proficiency in Microsoft Office Salary : The salary will be determined in accordance with Tdh Kenya salary scale based on the candidate's relevant professional experience. Tdh General Code of Conduct and Ethical Policies : Commits to promoting and complying with the Global Code of Conduct, systematically reporting any violations of the Code through Tdh's formal reporting mechanisms and dealing with any violations of procedures and processes appropriately. Raises awareness of the Foundation of the risks of policy non-compliance, violence and abuse, and related rights, towards children, community members and our own employees. Undertakes to comply with key ethical policies and guidelines, including the Safeguarding Policy, the Anti-Fraud and Corruption Policy, the Conflict-of-Interest Policy and other policies related to the prevention of terrorist financing and criminal activities, as well as workplace behavior. name: UI/UX Designer (1 Year Fixed Term Contract)
text: Job Purpose We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented UI Designer to join our dynamic team at Britam. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the design of intuitive and visually compelling user interfaces across a range of digital products, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about user-centered design, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is driven to create seamless and engaging user experiences. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with senior designers and project managers to create intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for web and mobile applications. Assist in the design and development of wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes, and user interface components using design tools such as Adobe XD, Sketch, or Figma. Participate in user research and usability testing activities to gather feedback and insights for iterative design improvements. Work closely with developers and other team members to ensure the effective implementation of UI designs, while maintaining consistency and usability across different platforms and devices. Stay updated on industry trends, design principles, and best practices in UI/UX design to support continuous improvement and innovation. Contribute ideas and solutions to enhance the user experience and visual appeal of digital products and interfaces. Document design processes, decisions, and guidelines to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration within the team. Knowledge, Experience, And Qualifications Required Degree in Computer Science, Interaction Design, HCI or any related field from an accredited institution Strong interest in UI/UX design and proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma, or similar software. Creative flair and a keen eye for detail, with a passion for creating elegant and user-friendly designs. Familiarity with design principles, typography, color theory, and layout techniques. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment. Ability to take constructive feedback and iterate on designs to achieve optimal outcomes. Enthusiasm for learning and a strong desire to develop skills and knowledge in UI design. Primary Location Kenya-Nairobi-Nairobi Job Type Contractual Shift Day Job Contract Type Full-time Job Posting 01-09-2026 Unposting Date Ongoing

Job Purpose

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented UI Designer to join our dynamic team at Britam. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the design of intuitive and visually compelling user interfaces across a range of digital products, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about user-centered design, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is driven to create seamless and engaging user experiences.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with senior designers and project managers to create intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
  • Assist in the design and development of wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes, and user interface components using design tools such as Adobe XD, Sketch, or Figma.
  • Participate in user research and usability testing activities to gather feedback and insights for iterative design improvements.
  • Work closely with developers and other team members to ensure the effective implementation of UI designs, while maintaining consistency and usability across different platforms and devices.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, design principles, and best practices in UI/UX design to support continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Contribute ideas and solutions to enhance the user experience and visual appeal of digital products and interfaces.
  • Document design processes, decisions, and guidelines to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration within the team.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Interaction Design, HCI or any related field from an accredited institution
  • Strong interest in UI/UX design and proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma, or similar software.
  • Creative flair and a keen eye for detail, with a passion for creating elegant and user-friendly designs.
  • Familiarity with design principles, typography, color theory, and layout techniques.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Ability to take constructive feedback and iterate on designs to achieve optimal outcomes.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and a strong desire to develop skills and knowledge in UI design.

html:
About Dalkia UK

At Dalkia, we're driven by a shared purpose: tackling climate change and building a better, more sustainable future. We bring together talented people who share knowledge, challenge each other and grow together.

Backed by EDF, Britain's biggest generator of low carbon electricity, we're a people-first culture. With 5,000 employees and £600m turnover, we combine the strength of a major group with a great culture, innovative mindset and inclusive values making Dalkia a great place to work and grow your career.

About The Role

We have an exciting opportunity for a Mobile Facilities Technician to join our team around the South Larnarkshire area on a full-time, permanent basis. This role is essential to the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of a school environment, carrying out day-to-day maintenance, inspections, and basic repairs.

You'll work both independently and as part of a wider team, ensuring facilities are maintained to a high standard and all health & safety requirements are met.

Key Responsibilities
  • Opening and closing the school in line with required occupancy times
  • Carrying out internal and external building inspections and reporting faults (e.g. leaks, damaged tiles) to the Help Desk
  • Completing non-specialist repairs as required
  • Ensuring planned preventative maintenance (PPM) tasks are completed within agreed timescales
  • Managing visitor sign-in/sign-out procedures and key control
  • Ensuring site inductions are completed for all contractors and visitors
  • Reviewing Risk Assessments and Method Statements for works being carried out
  • Maintaining accurate records of maintenance activities and repairs
  • Ensuring compliance with health & safety regulations and company policies
  • Supporting the safe and compliant operation of the school at all times

This list is not exhaustive, and the role may include other reasonable duties within the scope and grading of the post.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Understanding of safe working practices and health & safety legislation
  • Ability to work independently
  • Well organised, with the ability to prioritise workload
  • Flexible approach to working as part of a team
  • Previous experience in a maintenance environment

Desirable:
  • Experience in a Facilities or Maintenance Technician role

What We Offer
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days each year
  • Life Assurance
  • Private Medical Insurance (single cover), with the option to add partner/dependants
  • Access to wellbeing programmes
  • Employee Referral Bonus, with generous rewards for referring a friend

Our Values

People First – It starts with health, safety and wellbeing

Better Together – A collaborative team

Trusted Partners – Dedicated to our clients' success

Taking Responsibility – Making a positive difference

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

We're committed to an inclusive and fair recruitment process. If you need any adjustments please let us know, in confidence, our team is here to support you.

name: Specialist, Asset Management
text: We at Athena empower exceptional talent with boundless opportunities to achieve more. We achieve this by pairing exceptional Executive Partners (XPs) from the Philippines and Kenya with our driven clients and ensuring both receive ongoing support throughout the journey. The result is 10x more leverage, more time, and a greater impact on our clients' work and lives. With a waitlist growing by the day, Athena has already showcased compelling demand. As part of the Athena team, you will have an exponential opportunity, empowering the fiercely ambitious to reach the most audacious goals . Role Overview A Specialist, Asset Management at Athena is a critical role responsible for managing and optimizing the lifecycle of fixed assets, particularly focusing on the management of laptops and related equipment. This position ensures accurate reporting, compliance, and efficient logistical support to enhance employee productivity and satisfaction. You will also be tasked with identifying and implementing process improvements and leading projects for the team designed to enhance operational efficiency. By optimizing these processes, you will contribute to maintaining a high standard of asset management and ensuring the smooth operation of the company's assets lifecycle. Duties & Responsibilities Fixed Assets Management Supervise the reconciliation of stock tallies with units purchased from vendors to maintain precise inventory records and asset logistics management. Prepare comprehensive month-end reports and coordinate with relevant departments to ensure accurate collaboration and verification. Provide guidance and training to team members on best practices for asset management and reporting, fostering a culture of accuracy and accountability. End-to-End Laptop Logistics Ensure timely deployment of laptops from suppliers and custodians to users. Manage logistics for laptop retrievals and pickups using services such as LBC, Transportify, and Grab. Oversee the distribution and proper filing of equipment loan agreements and other related documents. Address and escalate laptop-related issues and challenges to ensure prompt resolution. Facilitate effective communication between laptop users and accredited service centers to guarantee efficient and timely repairs. Ensure all assets are accurately recorded and accounted for in the IT Asset Management (ITAM) system. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and improve service delivery, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals. Coach and mentor the team, promoting a proactive approach to problem-solving and process optimization. Administrative Responsibilities Maintain and regularly update relevant reports and trackers. Handle ad hoc tasks as assigned, ensuring they are completed efficiently. Provide support and resources to employees, manage departmental resources effectively, and foster engagement with the broader community. Ensure employees have the necessary tools, resources, and support throughout their employment journey. Key Stakeholders Vendors/Suppliers, Finance, Office and Facilities, Administration Skills Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication for effective engagement with community members, ensuring clarity in conveying information and fostering strong working relationships. Technical Skills: Proficiency in using Asset Panda (ITAM) for managing and tracking asset inventories. Proficiency with Google Workspace and Mac OS for seamless integration into the company's digital ecosystem. Advanced proficiency in Excel/Sheets, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis functions. Competencies Assertiveness and Initiative: Proactive in identifying process improvements and taking the lead in implementing solutions. Confident in making decisions and providing recommendations for asset management strategies. Analytics & Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills to interpret data and generate insights that drive asset management decisions. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to asset discrepancies, system inefficiencies, and logistical challenges. Customer Service: A customer-focused approach to addressing inquiries and resolving issues related to asset management. Skilled in maintaining positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service satisfaction. Attention to Detail: Meticulous in managing asset records, ensuring data accuracy and integrity. Thoroughly reviewing documents and reports to maintain compliance with audit standards. Job Requirements Willing to work fully onsite in our office in Nairobi. Willing and available to work during the graveyard shift and has the flexibility to work on any day of the week This role will be responsible for about at least one Analyst with plans to expand the span of control in the future. Relevant Experience Required At least 5 years of experience with the same or similar job function and responsibilities. Educational and Certification Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or other related field. Direct Reports and Span of Control This role will be responsible for about at least one Analyst with plans to expand the span of control in the future.
html:
We at Athena empower exceptional talent with boundless opportunities to achieve more. We achieve this by pairing exceptional Executive Partners (XPs) from the Philippines and Kenya with our driven clients and ensuring both receive ongoing support throughout the journey. The result is 10x more leverage, more time, and a greater impact on our clients' work and lives.

With a waitlist growing by the day, Athena has already showcased compelling demand. As part of the Athena team, you will have an exponential opportunity, empowering the fiercely ambitious to reach the most audacious goals.

Role Overview

A Specialist, Asset Management at Athena is a critical role responsible for managing and optimizing the lifecycle of fixed assets, particularly focusing on the management of laptops and related equipment. This position ensures accurate reporting, compliance, and efficient logistical support to enhance employee productivity and satisfaction. You will also be tasked with identifying and implementing process improvements and leading projects for the team designed to enhance operational efficiency. By optimizing these processes, you will contribute to maintaining a high standard of asset management and ensuring the smooth operation of the company's assets lifecycle.

Duties & Responsibilities

Fixed Assets Management
  • Supervise the reconciliation of stock tallies with units purchased from vendors to maintain precise inventory records and asset logistics management.
  • Prepare comprehensive month-end reports and coordinate with relevant departments to ensure accurate collaboration and verification.
  • Provide guidance and training to team members on best practices for asset management and reporting, fostering a culture of accuracy and accountability.

End-to-End Laptop Logistics
  • Ensure timely deployment of laptops from suppliers and custodians to users.
  • Manage logistics for laptop retrievals and pickups using services such as LBC, Transportify, and Grab.
  • Oversee the distribution and proper filing of equipment loan agreements and other related documents.
  • Address and escalate laptop-related issues and challenges to ensure prompt resolution.
  • Facilitate effective communication between laptop users and accredited service centers to guarantee efficient and timely repairs.
  • Ensure all assets are accurately recorded and accounted for in the IT Asset Management (ITAM) system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and improve service delivery, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.
  • Coach and mentor the team, promoting a proactive approach to problem-solving and process optimization.

Administrative Responsibilities
  • Maintain and regularly update relevant reports and trackers.
  • Handle ad hoc tasks as assigned, ensuring they are completed efficiently.
  • Provide support and resources to employees, manage departmental resources effectively, and foster engagement with the broader community.
  • Ensure employees have the necessary tools, resources, and support throughout their employment journey.

Key Stakeholders

Vendors/Suppliers, Finance, Office and Facilities, Administration

Skills
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication for effective engagement with community members, ensuring clarity in conveying information and fostering strong working relationships.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in using Asset Panda (ITAM) for managing and tracking asset inventories.
    • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Mac OS for seamless integration into the company's digital ecosystem.
    • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Sheets, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis functions.
Competencies
  • Assertiveness and Initiative:
    • Proactive in identifying process improvements and taking the lead in implementing solutions.
    • Confident in making decisions and providing recommendations for asset management strategies.
  • Analytics & Problem Solving:
    • Strong analytical skills to interpret data and generate insights that drive asset management decisions.
    • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to asset discrepancies, system inefficiencies, and logistical challenges.
  • Customer Service:
    • A customer-focused approach to addressing inquiries and resolving issues related to asset management.
    • Skilled in maintaining positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service satisfaction.
  • Attention to Detail:
    • Meticulous in managing asset records, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
    • Thoroughly reviewing documents and reports to maintain compliance with audit standards.
Job Requirements
  • Willing to work fully onsite in our office in Nairobi.
  • Willing and available to work during the graveyard shift and has the flexibility to work on any day of the week

This role will be responsible for about at least one Analyst with plans to expand the span of control in the future.

Relevant Experience Required
  • At least 5 years of experience with the same or similar job function and responsibilities.

Educational and Certification Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or other related field.

Direct Reports and Span of Control
  • This role will be responsible for about at least one Analyst with plans to expand the span of control in the future.

name: Concierge, Facilities and Office Services
text: Role Overview We are looking for an elegant, service-oriented Receptionist/Concierge to be the first point of contact for our distinguished guests, clients, and staff. The ideal candidate will embody refined professionalism, warm hospitality, and exceptional communication skills, creating an unforgettable first impression that reflects the Athena brand standards. This role combines front office management, concierge-level service, and administrative support, ensuring every guest interaction is seamless, personalized, and efficient. Duties & Responsibilities Front Office Operations Welcome and assist all visitors, clients, staff, and executives with courtesy and discretion, maintaining a premium, professional image at all times. Manage the reception area to ensure it remains immaculate, organized, and reflective of a five-star environment. Handle incoming calls, emails, and correspondence efficiently, ensuring prompt responses and accurate message delivery. Manage guest and staff sign-ins, visitor badges, and appointment schedules in coordination with the Facilities team. Concierge & Guest Relations Provide concierge-style assistance, arranging transport, meetings, refreshments, and special requests with attention to detail and care. Anticipate the needs of guests and staff, ensuring smooth coordination of all front-of-house services. Build strong relationships with vendors, drivers, and service providers to support high-quality client experiences. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of office amenities, dining, and hospitality options for staff recommendations. Administrative & Coordination Support Support the Facilities Team in daily administrative and operational tasks. Assist in event coordination, office hospitality setups, and meeting room preparation. Monitor inventory and order supplies for front office and staff areas. Maintain accurate visitor logs, reports, and front desk documentation. Key Stakeholders Both internal and external stakeholders Skills Impeccable grooming and presentation. Strong sense of ownership, discretion, and accountability. Service-driven mindset with a passion for excellence. Cross-cultural awareness and ability to work in a multinational environment. Flexible and solution-oriented, with the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. Competencies Proven background in 5-star hotel environments or executive-level property management. Demonstrated expertise in front office operations and client service Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage high expectations with tact, efficiency, and confidentiality. Proficiency in Google Workspace, MacOS, and familiarity with hospitality or property management systems. Relevant Experience Required Minimum 2 years of experience in a front office, concierge, or guest relations role, preferably within a 5-star hotel, luxury office, or premium real estate environment. Educational And Certification Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field. Direct Reports and Span of Control Individual Contributor

name: Senior Recruiter
text: Join our employee-owned team as a Senior Recruiter and play a defining role in shaping PC Construction’s regional growth! In this senior level role, you will lead our proactive talent acquisition strategy and grow our people and culture initiatives. In office presence required: This position requires a full-time, Monday–Friday physical presence in one of our regional offices FL, GA, NC, or VT office to collaborate with the team and support executives. Your primary focus will be identifying, engaging, and pipelining top-tier construction talent for our expanding Northern regions. In this role, you’ll lead the talent acquisition and recruitment process for our Northern regions, building and facilities projects, and core departments, collaborating closely with the recruiting and human resources team as well as hiring managers. You will implement effective recruiting strategies, guiding candidates through the hiring process, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience before their first day. We’re looking for someone with a passion for full-cycle, hands-on recruitment and a positive attitude, who thrives in a fast-paced environment while partnering with our collaborative and supportive HR team. Benefits Profit sharing bonus 401(k) with a generous company match Employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) Health, dental, vision, company paid disability, life insurance and leaves Paid time off and holidays upon hire Annual reviews and training and development opportunities with career growth 100% EMPLOYEE OWNED PC Construction is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. About PC Construction: PC offers general contracting, construction management and design-build services to private and public clients across the country. The company manages projects along the east coast from its headquarters in Vermont and a network of locations in Florida, Georgia, Maine, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina and the Mid-Atlantic. From specialized buildings to complex water and wastewater treatment plants, PC is ranked annually as one of the top contractors in the country. A construction industry leader for over 68 years, PC Construction is guided to success by its team of dedicated employee-owners. This position has a pay range of $78,000 - $90,000 annual salary, depending on experience, in addition to an extensive benefits package that includes company stock, and a profit-sharing bonus. Key Responsibilities Create requisitions for open positions, in partnership with executives and hiring managers. Identify and implement efficient and effective recruiting methods and strategies based on the available role, industry standards, and needs of the company. Write recruitment ads and place advertisements for all open positions on social and other appropriate media. Serve as the main contact for recruitment inquiries and sourcing, including both internal and external candidates. Source and evaluate resumes for open positions, including both internal and external candidates; utilize LinkedIn and Indeed to source and build pipelines. Maintain frequent written and verbal communication with all applicants throughout recruitment process. Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews for both internal and external candidates. Lead PC’s interview and selection best practices and train interviewers. Organize and communicate interview structure and questions to interviewers. Lead post-interview evaluation meetings with interview team. Working in partnership with the hiring manager develop offer letters based on company policies and standards. Manage all aspects of onboarding for the candidates sourced by this position: ensure pre-employment drug screening and E-Verify process is complete; vehicles, technology equipment as well as cleaned and prepared workspaces upon their first day of employment. Lead onboarding efforts, including coordination for first days of employment, and send out welcome boxes. Continually evaluate applicant tracking system and on-boarding products, software, and methods to maintain best practices. Research, track, and analyze emerging AI trends and technologies, applying these insights to forecast talent needs and design forward-thinking recruitment strategies, in collaboration with recruiting team. Lead workforce planning efforts, in coordination with HR team and executives. Manage and educate PC employees on the referral programs. Conduct training for PC Employees on topics within your area of expertise. Develop and maintain PC’s presence on social media sites and on PC Construction’s website and Intranet. Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and company policies. Assist HR team members in the layout and design of marketing materials, flyers, postcards, brochures, and other materials; maintain recruiting supplies and inventory. Support the HR team with various projects as needed. Travel to career fairs and jobsites as needed. Strong verbal, written, communication, and organizational skills are essential. We are looking for someone with a minimum of five to ten years’ experience in recruiting. Experience in recruiting construction professionals is highly preferred.
